Dialogues: ['No. Not yet... ', 'That boy... ', 'Welcome to the Honeybee Inn... Cloud. You seek my approval, do you? I understand. The empty suit that's just a mouthpiece for Shinra?", "Guess we're supposed to follow.", "Look at this place! So what—you telling me the mayor's some kind of crazy bookworm?", "If this is a trap, you're a dead man, y'hear?", "This can't be right.", 'Say what?', 'Huh. Well, this oughta make things easier.', "But the president's gonna get his too—if I have anything to say about it.", 'Great.', "Hold up. You telling me that that's the best you can do?", "Okay! ', "The hell's that?", 'Does training in that thing really make you better?', "That's right.", 'Say what?', 'Think they like surprises? We can even take the president as a hostage. Hojo's getting away!", "Cocky little egghead, ain'tcha.", "Y'all 'bout to learn predictable.", 'She only came here to save Marlene!', 'Looks like your models got it wrong.', 'What are those things up to this time?', 'Got it. Stand back.', 'Thanks for saving Marlene. I owe you one.', 'The hell was that thing?', 'What the—!?', 'What? You wanna go?', 'Uhh... So what the hell is it?', 'So, we gonna go get the son of a bitch?', "Don't scare us like that, man.", 'Not enough sleep?', 'Yeah, well... Honestly I thought that part was just a fairy tale.', "Even if you could, that land belongs to the—I mean... To you and your people. Shinra's after it because they believe it's rich in mako—mako they've got no right to claim. But they'll try to take it anyway, won't they? Hmph. Greedy bastards'll never stop.", "Okay. New plan. Y'all take Aerith and get the hell outta here. Me, I'mma go bust some Shinra heads.", 'Oh, great. These assholes again! Probably some Shinra science experiment.', "So if we're destined for a bleak future, these Whispers will try to keep us on that course? Now wait just a damn minute! How in the hell can you possibly know any of that? Spouting that cryptic stuff—which could all be bullshit! I mean, ain't you a Shinra lab rat—dog?", 'Weird... ', 'Wedge!?', "Y-you shouldn't be up and moving!", "HQ's bailing us out? I doubt it. Not after all the shit we've pulled.", "I didn't ask him to do any of that.", "Huh? Heh. I'mma still chew him out for it later.", 'Anyway, we gotta get to the roof, right?', 'That elevator. Was it this way?', 'What happened here?', 'Now what do we do?', "So go give 'em one already!", 'Nice job!', 'What?', 'Shit—what the hell Red!?', 'Hell is this place?', "What I wouldn't give to burn it all down... but we need to get to the roof.", 'What is that... ?', 'What kind of freak show have they got going on in here?', 'Stay back!', "Yeah, right! Just having a little bit of fun with them, that's all.", 'Long as it took you to get here?', "Shit, it's like they're churning out monsters here.", 'Hey... You okay?', 'If you say so.', "First, we find Tifa and Aerith. Then we head for the roof. Should be an elevator somewhere. Didn't expect any of this, but we just gotta roll with it. Come on, let's go.", "All right. Now you're starting to impress me.", "Yeah! Keep it up, y'all!", "Huh? I can't hear what you're saying!", 'What!?', '"Necessary preparations"? What the hell is this asshole talking about?', "We'll be waiting right here. If anything happens—anything at all—you call us. All right?", 'The hell kind of "research" is this?', "I don't give a shit about any of that.", 'Hmph! So this asshole thinks he can treat us like his experiments.', "Wait sec. Weren't the girls right by the door to the 3rd ward?", 'What the—?', "Roger that. Was gettin' pretty bored anyway.", "Why don'tcha come down here and ask me?", "Hey! We ain't done yet!", "How'd ya like watchin' your precious toys get torn to shreds!?", "Look! Now's our chance to kill the bastard! Time for you to pay the piper!", 'Shit. Looks like Red might need our help up there!', "C'mon! We're going!", 'Get outta here!', 'What was that thing?', "Remind me. This ain't a hospital, is it?", "This guy's a real piece of work... ", 'Now what!?', 'Hey, let us out!', 'I remember you!', 'Fine! One step at a time it is.', "Huh, whaddya know. That's the door to the 4th ward.", 'But the door we used to get here is shut. So what now?', "It's a PHS terminal. Call up Tifa, see if they can get to the central terminal.", 'Hey! You okay down there?', "Shit! He can't hold them off forever!", 'You should call Tifa.', 'Nice one!', 'Right. Now we head back to that door.', 'We, uh, made Wedge wait a while to be rescued.', 'You know, he really likes you.', 'Friendly guy, but he has a hard time opening up to people.', "He's got your back, though. Heh... makes two of us.", 'Huh. You hear that?', "Flyin' fishbot here's trying to turn us into mincemeat!", "It's outta control!", "We don't have all day, you know.", 'Uh... Cloud... ', "Oh... hey. Band's back together. Past time we got outta here and made our way to the roof.", ' Glad to hear he enjoyed the show.', 'Hey.', "What the hell's going on?", "So what's above this floor?", 'Where the hell is that bastard hiding?', 'Well, well, well... ', "Thing is, I don't want your money.", "I'm a man of modest dreams. Dropping you from seventy stories up would get me damn near to good.", 'More than this right here? Talk to me again like you know me.', "You're gonna get on TV and tell 'em. Tell 'em what you did to Sector 7—that it was you who killed all those people! Then, you're gonna tell them the truth about Avalanche. That Avalanche ain't Wutai or anybody's puppet! That Avaalnche fights for the people—the planet! That we fight to hold Shinra to account for its crimes! That is Avalanche! The filthy sewer rats... who brought down a goliath! You tell 'em that.", 'Huh? Damn.', 'And what about you Mister President. What are your vaunted principles?', 'You son of a bitch!', "Don't think so.", 'Thanks.', 'Hey. Get your man?', "Huh. 'Bout time we made our escape too.", "If it ain't Rufus Shinra. Heir to the throne himself.", 'Huh!? The hell I will! We can finish off the family here and now!', 'I could stay here—back you up.', 'Fine. Have it your way then. But you better be right behind us.', 'What was that!?', 'Gotta believe they made it out.', 'Dammit!', 'Screw it—we gotta go back!', 'What, Red!?', 'Get down!', 'Hey. Still in one piece?', 'Oh, you gotta be kidding me!', 'Okay, you asked for it, mech! Open wide! And suck on this!', 'I was born ready, Red.', 'We piss it off?', 'Any ideas!?', "If more come, we're done.", 'Not this again!', 'Damn, does it feel good to be alive!', 'The hell they are!', 'All we gotta do now is find the others.', 'Avalanche!', 'Up your ass.', "Aerith. You saved my Marlene. Now... it's time I returned the favor.", "Why's he always gotta— Whoa! Shit.", 'Home free, Red!', 'Man, you need to lighten up. Hell, you might even try smiling.', "On second thought... maybe frowning suits you better. Hey, don't pout!", 'Whoa! Are you guys seeing this!?', "It's like the whole damn building's made of 'em.", "Wedge—you don't think he got caught up in it do you?", 'Who?', "This, we don't need.", "They're gainin' on us! C'mon, step on it!", "How the hell'd we get saddled with this junker!?", 'No... dammit... ', 'Stubborn bastards!', ' And let that be a lesson to you!', "That chopper is all mine! I'll bring it down real quick!", ' Try catching us now, ya bastards!', 'Cloud! Keep your guard up!', "That's it! Now seize the opening and attack!", 'Ha ha *ha*! How do you like that!?', 'Them again!?', 'Guess we owe you another!', "Shit! We got incoming! I'll take the chopper! The bikes are all yours, Cloud!", 'Ha! Think you can take us? Well think again, asshole!', "That's it—I'm takin' you down!", 'We done here!?', "So now... they're on our side?", "Oh no, don't you *dare*!", "C'mon! You see the piece of shit we're driving here!?", 'Hey!', 'Get your ass in gear!', 'Time for a serious ass-whooping!', 'Time to meet your maker!', "Okay, y'all! Let's finish him off! C'mon!", 'Nice!', "So if we go through that thing, there's no coming back?", "I don't know what kind of freedom we're buying... but I know it'll cost us.", "Wouldn't be the first time I spit in destiny's eye. Whether you can see the seams or you can't... doesn't change that she's always trying to have it her way.", "Daddy's coming home real soon, honey!", "Don't know about you, but looks normal to me.", "Okay, that ain't right!", "You're alive!", "Wouldn't go that far.", 'Looks a lot more like an "arbiter of fate" than the others.', 'Ha! Bring it on!', "Come on, that ain't fair!", 'We gotta go!', 'Shit! Look out! Run dammit, run! Move your ass!', 'We gotta get outta here now!', 'Did we do it!?', 'What the hell did I just see?', 'Dammit! How do we stop these things!?', 'Them again? Least they could do is give us a little breather!', "In that case, ultra big boy's all mine!", "Ain't no stoppin' us now!", 'Gotcha!', "I'm gonna show you what Avalanche is made of!", 'What the hell is this!?', "Ain't you two havin' fun!", 'Better late than never!', 'We get him!?', "'Bout time you showed!", 'We get him!?', "'Bout time you showed!", 'Go!', 'Marlene!', "I'll come back.", 'I thought you beat him.', "I'm in too! Bastard wants to destroy the whole planet, doesn't he? An enemy of hers is an enemy of Avalanche!", 'We lost him.', "Well... of course he will! A little fall ain't gonna stop a hard-ass like him. He'll come swaggerin' back before long, you mark my words.", 'Is that so?', "Don't got time for no low-level mobsters. We got Shinra in our sights.", 'Tifa. You and I both know this is far from over. Right? Might as well get some rest—while we still can.', 'Yup.', "'Nother full day, give or take.", 'Gotta go with Elmyra on that one.', "Cloud. Bet you've had to hoof it from sunup to sundown tons of times. This is all just same old, same old, right?", "Yeah, yeah, I know... Anyway, marchin' into the unknown ain't easy, but don't worry, 'cause I'm here to lead the way!", "Alright, everyone—let's stop here for a minute. Leader's orders! Now breathe in that fresh air!", "Actally, scratch that. Let's, uh... save it for later. When we're not so close to Midgar.", 'Hey! Stop!', 'What is it with these damn birds!?', "That's its way of telling you it's hungry. Let's move."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Lookie here, boys! Caught us some burglars!', 'I\'d say we\'re owed "compensatory damages"!', "How stupid can you be? It's crazy simple! Compensatory damages is like, uh... It's like... compensation... For damages!", "Nothing but our due recompense—that's all!", 'No, shit-for-brains! "Due recompense"! It\'s like... uh... It\'s like... uh... Compensatory damages!', 'Simple as that!', "Okay, guys. Whatever you do... don't move... ", "Shit! Let's get the hell outta here!", "Well, hot damn! Been fixin' to feed you two your just desserts! So open wide, 'cause we're gonna serve up a heapin' helpin'!", 'Like *justice*! Like *payback*!', "The only rule here is that there are no rules! If Corneo says it's okay, then you gotta suck it up!", "Damn, you two are *really* somethin' else. I could use that kinda muscle in my gang.", "Hey! It's you!", "Shuddup! It's too late for that. Bring it. We're ready for you this time! Wakey wakey! Time to shine.", 'Check out this brick shithouse! We picked him up at the colosseum! Gonna pay you back double—nah, quadruple for what you done to us!', 'Shut your trap, moron!', 'Hey, watch it! Not so rough, you lummox.', "Not so fast! You wanna come through here, you'll need to provide due compens— You again!?", 'Stop lying! We go way back!']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Hey... where'd you guys go?", 'Oh, hey there! Uhh, is Marlene with you?', 'Oh, okay. I was kinda hoping she could help me find my friends.', "Really!? Okay! Lemme tell you all about them. They have long arms and legs. And they're a little skinny. They like places where there's food. And nice people who give them treats when they ask! And small spaces! Oh yeah, and they're all cats!", "They're friendly, so if you call them, they'll come running. All three of them! Find my friends. Please!", 'They love crowded places, like the road to the station. A lot of people stop to play with them there.', "They'll also go wherever there's free food. Marlene says she always gives them some snacks when they go to Seventh Heaven.", "I see a lot of cats hanging out near the Beginner's Hall, too. You know the place. It's the one with all the houses around it.", "What? They ran away? So... I'm never gonna see them again?", 'You guys! You came back! They said that a scary man was chasing them! Thank you!', 'Daddy!', 'I really hope that all my friends are okay.', "Everyone's so sad... Think, think... ", 'Oh, heya!', "You too! Uh, where's Marlene? Is she okay?", "Really? I'm so glad! Hey, can you help me with something? I'm looking for music discs for the jukebox. I think some new music might cheer people up—make them happy!", 'You know I will! Thanks!', 'Hope you guys find some really good ones.', 'I just want people to smile more.', 'Thanks a bunch!', "Hmm, I don't think this song's doing it. People still seem kinda sad. I'm still seeing a lot of frowns.", "Hmm, I don't think this song's doing it. People still seem kinda sad. I'm still seeing a lot of frowns.", "Ooh, I like this one. It's really peaceful, don't you think?", 'Sure!', 'Wow, what a song! It makes me feel like I can do anything!', 'I know this one! Marlene and I danced to it before.', 'Tell me if you find more music discs!', "Isn't this great!? Everyone's smiling again. Thanks so much for the help!", 'Make sure to bring Marlene next time!', "I'll be here if you wanna listen to more!", 'Hi there, moogle! Are you here for the story?', 'I bet you like Stamp too, huh!']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['You got this!', 'Cloud. Cloud Strife.', "And he isn't a SOLDIER anymore. Still, he's a professional—unlike the rest of us. I'm glad to have him.", 'Real joy to work with though.', 'Here we go... ', "Enough. We're done here.", 'Give it a rest.', 'This way!', "Not so fast. We've got company.", "In three, two... Damn, I'm good!", 'I got this place covered.', "Well, what're you waiting for?", 'Careful in there.', "Well, what're you waiting for?", 'I got this place covered.', "But the planet's what matters, right?", "I mean... this must've helped *some*.", "Ugh, the air in here reeks. Can't wait to get out in the open!", " Man, what *is* that? I've never smelled anything so foul. (sniffs) Aw, it's me. Gotta do something about that, and soon.", 'They just keep on coming.', 'Hey, we can figure that out later.', "Can't wait to take a hot shower.", 'You sure told those doors.', "This couldn't have been us... could it?", 'Yeah... We always knew this was gonna get messy.', "So, what's our next move, boss?", "No need to assume the worst. I'm sure he's fine. You saw him in action, didn't you? Guy's a SOLDIER. Goddamn one-man army.", "Well—can't argue with the results, huh?", 'Thought they were invisible.', "'Cause of the evacuation order, maybe?", 'Hey, got a sec?', "You're uh... holding up pretty well, huh? Even after what we saw at the station and all over Sector 8?", 'Well... my hands are still shaking.', 'Something to look forward to... Or maybe not.', "Well, I get it if you can't relate... ", 'Shower might help. A long, hot one... ', "Don't wander off, huh?", 'Yes!', 'And one step closer to a brighter future!', "That hot shower can't come soon enough. I can barely tell my skin from all the ash and sweat.", 'And you, Jessie?', "Hah! You're such a kidder.", 'Umm... lots of stuff, really. But our top priority is taking care of any beasts that wander into town. That, and teaching the locals how to defend themselves.', "Truth be told, we could really use your help. We can't pay you in girl, but we'll work something out. For example... Aha, what about your sword? I could mod it for you.", "You some kind of a purist? I know *I'd* never pass up a chance to improve my gear. C'mon... at least let me show you how it's done.", "All set? Needless to say, you'll have to try it out to appreciate the difference.", "We'll do you one better—spread the word to everyone who'll listen about the new merc in town.", 'Scrap Boulevard. Good hunting.', "Just so you know, the watch relies on residents' donations for funding.", "This isn't just a cover—we really do wanna keep the neighborhood safe. We grew up here, after all.", 'Lemme have a look at your sword when you get back, huh?', 'Back already?', 'Good job. Meanwhile, we told everyone we could about you.', "How's the sword, by the way?", 'Glad to hear it. Seems like the perfect fit for you.', "Oh, no you won't. Run along now, you two. Go on.", "Think about it for a second. They haven't seen each other in years. You'd be a third wheel!", "Jessie, what's the holdup?", 'Avalanche!', 'Glug, glug, glug, glug... Ahhh! That hit the spot!', 'Yep! Best way to clear your head so. you can focus when it counts!', 'No need for that, boss. We all knew what we were signing up for.', "Happy to look out for you, like I know you'll look out for me.", 'Avalanche!', "Can't expect anyone but a true believer to stand tall if everything goes sideways.", 'Could get pretty dicey out there.', "Sorry. Boss man wasn't having it.", "Tough break. They changed the times. Last train's already left. Which is why we borrowed these bikes. Need a lift to the plate?", "Yeah, and don't get me started on all that pep.", 'Nailed it, huh?', "So—seeing as we don't have any family of our own... How about you let us be a part of yours for a bit? You know, spread the wealth.", 'Yeah!', "Yes, ma'am!", 'Crank that throttle!', 'So far so good!', 'And that is?', 'Oh, man!', 'Straight to lethal force!?', "Eh... You've got a point.", "More of 'em!?", 'Got more company!', "One thing after another... C'mon Wedge, gun it!", 'Nothing about this is good!', 'Fair enough! Alright then, do your thing!', "That's an ex-SOLDIER for ya. Next to him, we look like kids on trikes.", 'You\'re part of that "we" too, you know.', 'Woo-hoo! Topside!', "Why ya talking like we're not here?", 'Clearly we are!', 'Not over yet! Cloud! Little help!?', "Who's this!?", 'We did it!', ' They got you pretty good.', 'Folks here must be living off three or four times what I do.', "She's quite the cook. Quick to whip up finger-lickin' food even if you drop by in the dead of night.", 'Yeah, like a dog!', 'This is amazing!', "You've still got room, Wedge?!", 'Aw, thank you!', 'Now that is a damn good pie.', 'Wedge!', "All right, let's get to it.", 'So... we came all this way just to eat pizza!?', "You know damn well what she means. While you're inside, we make sure the guards are focused on the outside. Yeah?", "You're gonna run this guy into the ground, aren'tcha?", 'Hold on. How are we supposed to get back to the slums? Wait for the first train?', "Well, that diversion's not gonna create itself.", "Jessie's dad was in there, right?", 'Mako poisoning. Happened while Jessie was doing a show at the Gold Saucer— Ah, but what do you care?', 'Jessie always wanted to be an actress. Worked her ass off for years until finally she caught a break. Top billing. Parents were thrilled. And then... right before opening night... ', "Collapsed from overwork... and in the worst possible place. Mako storage. Lay there half a day before someone found him. Been like that ever since. No change whatsoever. That's what got her into planetology, and led her to seek out Avalanche. How far we've come... ", "He'll get caught up in the flow and... poof.", "What's so funny?", 'I see... ', "Mako's the essence of life itself. Of memory and hope. It's not something you burn in a reactor just to keep the lights on. Hell no.", "Oh—don't tell Jessie about this little chat, okay? When she gets pissed, she gets punchy.", 'This guy!', 'Gotta stay hidden—wait for the signal.', 'Just need to get past this gate.', 'Looks like someone beat us here.', 'This had better not get in the way of our plans... ', "Don't see anyone. What the hell happened?", "No need for us to rush. Let's scout it out first.", "What, you're trying to keep us out of it now? Don't be a jackass.", "If you need to check your gear, now's the time. Give the word when you're good to go.", "Guess there's a training center too. Could go a few rounds before the main event.", "Remind me—you've got summoning materia, don't you? There's no better way to deal with big groups. You'd be crazy not to equip it.", "Okay. Let's go over the plan one last time. You start things off by cutting loose where everyone can see you.", "We're the backup. First, we climb high enough to get a vantage point—then we go to town on 'em.", 'All according to plan.', 'Right!', 'Oh, you gotta be shitting me.', 'Gimme a bit more time and I got you.', 'Goodbye! And good riddance.', 'Look at us amateurs putting in the work.', ' Helluva show, man! If only the ladies loved you that much!', 'Of course they store mechs here... ', 'Hell yeah!', 'Well, shit.', "Right. C'mon!", 'Right!', "C'mere.", "Wedge'll be fine. But you won't be if they start asking questions.", "First guests to the party. Another Avalanche cell. Our holier-than-thou friends from the old guard... It's always their way or the highway. Lately they've been a real pain in the ass... Till now.", "Beats me. We've been on the outs ever since our cell got labeled too extreme... though they're the ones running around with mil-spec gear. Word is they've cut a deal with Wutai... Promised 'em all the materia in Midgar, apparently. Think there's any truth to that?", "Sometimes I think we're the only ones who've realized the war is over.", "Okay—mission complete. Let's make our way back to the lot.", 'Looking a lot more crowded now.', 'Just what we need.', "If we stuck around or went back, he'd only get upset.", "Guess a SOLDIER wouldn't understand... I'll tell him you were worried about him, though. Who knows—might just make his day.", 'Hey, buddy. How you doing?', "C'mon... ", 'You get hit?', 'Really? Let me see... ', 'Copy that!', "Man, can't believe HQ was running an op tonight of all nights.", "That or a bad omen. If they're ramping up for something, could get messy. Add it to the pile of complications to think about.", 'Sure hope so.', 'Hey! What the hell, man!?', "Sure did! Wants a whole pie to himself, isn't that right?", 'Super-duper awesome!', 'Parachutes?', "Sure. Okay, who's ready to fly!?", 'Hey Cloud—you let him down gently, alright?', 'Not if you do first!', "Feels like we're flying high these days!", "He's a keeper all right.", "Oh, hey, Cloud! Survived the jump? How's Wedge?", "Well, that's good to hear. Tomorrow's a really big day for all of us. When Wedge said he'd been shot, I was afraid we'd have to call off the whole damn thing. Heading topside in secret... Don't think I could've faced Barret if something had happened. But Jessie'd been acting weird and I knew I couldn't just ignore her.", 'Huh? Sorry. Our chute was blown pretty far off course. It... felt like a bad omen or something... so... ', 'Roger.', 'Night. And thanks. Really.', "Tomorrow's gonna be a success, I know it. We've all put in the work.", 'Lesson one for life on the ground floor. "A good long rest\'ll cure anything." Thanks for the refresher.', "'Preciate you coming.", 'Mercy!', "Wait... Cloud? Where's Jessie and Wedge?", "Topside's going nuts after some terrorists jumped off a train. Nice and quiet here, though. So quiet I had no trouble securing your route into the reactor.", 'So—where are the others?', 'Bad?', 'Thanks for stepping up.', "Worked out pretty good, you picking that train you did. While Shinra scours Sector 4... You can waltz right on into Sector 5. It's a bit of a squeeze, but it ought to get you where you need to go.", "Beggars can't be choosers. Oh—and you'll be needing your grappling guns, of course. All set?", 'Will do!', "'Bout time you showed up, merc. Gotta do my part to clear the path before you steal the show.", 'You made it... though... I might not. Hey. Is Wedge... ', "It's... pretty bad up there. Cloud. Promise me. Don't let it be for nothing.", "You're a good man. Giving me that... that comfort.", "I've still got some fight left in me. 'Nough for another platoon or two. Don't gotta be a SOLDIER... to make a difference.", 'Lemme guess... not a fan of kids.', 'But you have... so much in common.', 'Good luck... Cloud. Our future... is in your hands.', "Well, judging from the news, they didn't get caught. They'll turn up.", 'Heh heh... ', "Well, look who it is. Lovin' your work! So how many reactors is that now? Wait... Where's Cloud?", 'You what?', "Speakin' of sons of bitches... I heard the Wall Market's very own Don Corneo has his stooges out lookin' for ya.", 'Good luck out there.']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: [' Ready to rumble, huh?', 'And you... eat these things?', ' Guess you do.', 'Hey, you gonna be okay out there? Got all the info you need?', 'My teeth... ', ' Ignorance truly is bliss, huh?', "Haha, didn't mean to offend you. Of course, you probably knew this already, but there's a whole other city built on the plate above us. Shinra Building's right in the middle. You can't miss it.", 'Now, if ya wanna get topside, ya first gotta get outta the slums. Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Candidate detected. Performing physical analysis... Sizable weapon, excellent cardiovascular health and impressive lung capacity. Perfectly balanced muscle and bone structure... An optimal candidate!', "My name is Chadley. I'm an intern for Shinra's Research and Development Division. I hope you'll be interested in helping me with my research. Please accept this as a down payment.", 'I would like you to set that Assess materia in your equipment and use it to gather intelligence in battle. This data will help me to develop new types of materia.', "You should know that I work actively to undermine Shinra's efforts. I'm sure you of all people can appreciate the tremendous power of materia—as well as how it might be wielded against your corporate enemies. And if you later decide that I am not worthy of your trust, you can do what you do best.", "Excellent! Then we shall work together so long as you deem fit. Once you've completed your task, please return and report to me.", 'Please set the orb of Assess materia to your equipment, and use it to whether battle intel.', 'Cloud. You were the first to gather the data I requested. Here is the rest of your payment. I have developed new materia. Would you like to see it?', "I plan to develop more materia in the future. Together, we can harness enough power to take down Shinra. I'll be preparing more battle intel reports, which I hope you will assist me in completing.", 'I look forward to receiving all of your future battle intel submissions.', 'I hope you will continue to help me gather vital information for my research.', "I've done it. I've developed a new materia!", 'I have to tell you that I am grateful for all of your help thus far.', "Cloud, I've come up with the most fascinating theory. Perhaps you can lend me your assistance in gathering data to test it?", 'Cloud. You have exceeded my expectations.', 'Cloud, I have the most amazing news! I believe I might know how to develop summoning materia, something heretofore thought impossible. Scientists say that this materia can only be found in nature, but I may just be able to prove otherwise! And so, Cloud, I turn to you. I would like to test this theory by way of my combat simulator—to wit, I want you to fight and defeat summon data in VR. I sense that you find my phrasing to be somewhat... obtuse.', 'Then I invite you to ready your portable battle simulator.', 'What a shame. It was a close match. However, I did manage to obtain valuable data. Analyze and learn from your mistakes, so that you can claim victory next time.', "Outstanding. The Shiva summoning materia is complete. And now it's yours. Use it as you see fit. The lady of frost is the perfect companion for a man like you, Cloud. She will prove most useful when the time comes to destroy Shinra.", "Cloud! I understand you must be busy, but I hope you haven't forgotten about my research.", 'Oh, hello. Cloud has been assisting me with my research and development.', "One moment while I run diagnostics. Huh... How very strange... You don't appear to be in my database... ", "There must have been some sort of server error. Oh well, any friend of Cloud's is sure to be of great help.", 'Cloud! I will go wherever my research leads me, but the success of my endeavors rests entirely upon you. Your assistance would be much appreciated.', "Cloud, I've registered a new summons battle intel request. Please take a look. I need you to defeat the summoned entity so I can complete the materia.", 'Truly amazing work, Cloud! This is incontrovertible proof that the universe has a sense of humor. Now that you have a fun new partner in Fat Chocobo, you can work together to squash Shinra like a bug.', "Ohhh... Ahem. Forgive me, miss, but the way you're staring at me is rather... O-oh goodness... I'm experiencing an emotional response... ", 'What is this emotional response... ?', "Cloud! I'm glad to see that you're okay. In these trying times I hope to develop new materia to help us endure.", 'Marvelous! Leviathan, the patron deity of Wutai, is not an enemy to be trifled with. Together, you can cleanse the world of the Shinra scourge.', 'Now that was a battle! What an impressive feat to hold your own against one of the most exalted summons known to man. Together with the legendary Bahamut, I have every confidence you can expunge Shinra from existence. Such bravery... incredible!', "Cloud. I've been waiting for you. You haven't forgotten me, have you? I'm an intern in the R&D Division here. I took the liberty of hacking into the executives' private network to monitor your progress through the building. I will support you in any way that I can. I sense a surge in trust. We should keep this brief to avoid suspicion.", 'That should be everything. Initiate projection sequence.', 'What do you make of the new form, Weiss? We’ve replicated everything about you, from thought patterns to stress responses. You should, however, notice some improvements in my latest update. Indeed, I’d venture to say you’re stronger now than you’ve ever been.', 'Given that this is merely a training exercise—no one.', 'Cloud… We’ve added a new individual’s data to the combat simulator. I can’t divulge any details…but I can say its existence is both highly-classified and extremely dangerous. To be completely honest…I had some misgivings about implementing it. Even now, I’m still not entirely sure I made the right decision. However, I do believe that engaging it in combat will yield vital information. And who better to extract that information than you, Cloud? If you’re willing to try, I’d appreciate the help.', "Now that my research is at long last complete... I believe that it's time I told you the truth about myself. I'm... not human. I'm a cyborg created to serve as Hojo's assistant. I was given knowledge and power beyond that of a human... ... But I was robbed of free will, bound to obey the whims of my master. But when we met, Cloud, I sensed something within you—something I knew would allow me to break free of my chains. By identifying and studying a subject with infinite potential such as yourself... I could adhere to the directives imposed upon me... all the while pursuing my plans for independence in secret. Your combat data provided me the vital information that I required to enhance my basic functionality... This is the result. Through my research and with your assistance, I have freed myself from Hojo's bondage.", "I cannot thank you enough for your help. You've given me the power to finally live my life on my own terms.", "I'm not sure. It's all a big, wonderful mystery. It's nice not knowing something for a change... ", 'Searching for candidates... ', 'Candidate detected. Performing physical analysis. She seems relatively agile, and has substantial muscle mass for her stature. Hm. An acceptable candidate.', 'My apologies. My name is Chadley. Would you be interesting in helping me with my research?', 'Combat. It would entail doing battle with a summon in a virtual arena using this portable simulator. Interested?', 'Very well then... ', "Can I assume you're ready to do battle with a virtual summon?", "You're withdrawing? That is... most disheartening.", 'What a shame. It was a close match. However, I did manage to obtain some invaluable data. Analyze and learn from your mistakes, so that you can claim victory next time.', 'Splendid! Thanks to the data you provided during your battle, I succeeded in developing a new materia! One might say you were "faster than lightning." And with the Lord of Levin on your side, your enemies will struggle to keep up!', "If you'd like to participate again, you're more than welcome!", 'You "kicked its butt," like you promised.', 'Searching for competitors... ', 'Competitor detected. Initiating proficiency analysis... ', 'Hell, Yufife. I\'ve finished reviewing your Fort Condor match records. You exhibit what in sporting parlance is called "the ability to perform in the clutch," and "the heart of a champion." In combination, these traits make you the ideal player! That being the case, if it isn\'t too much trouble, would you mind testing your mettle against me?', 'I\'m sure you\'ll "kick butt"!', 'That was quite the performance, Yuffie! Thanks to you, my hypothesis has been substantiated.', ' My apologies. What I meant to say was this: The money and the materia are yours. Do with them as you please.', 'Heh. Your capacity to remain undeterred and overcome adversity is commendable. You are truly a worthy competitor. When I next test a hypothesis, I would be honored if you would agree to... ... "kick its butt"!', 'Shame; it was a close match. Maybe next time.', 'Would you care to assist in my research by joining me in a game or two of Fort Condor?']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["What's all the ruckus out here? Hmm... I don't know you. What's your story?", "Depends. What d'you want with this girl of yours?", "So that's how it is, huh? Do what you gotta, but leave me out of it. I told you what you wanna know—now take a walk.", "Not you two again. Told you once, I'll tell you a thousand times—got nothin' for you. Now scram.", 'Huh?', 'Why not.', "Sure. Next time an audition comes round, I'll put your name in the hat.", "You want in now? No can do, sweetheart. I already recommended Tifa, and she's got this in the bag.", "Damn, you really do want in, don't you?", "Then how's about we play for it? Call it, missy. Heads or tails. Guess right, and I'll grant you your wish. Guess wrong, and you'll leave me in peace.", 'Tails. You lose.', 'Heads. You lose.', 'Oh? Not a gambler, huh?', 'Tails. You lose.', "Hey, don't look so glum. You're a pretty enough gal, just... not quite Corneo's cup of tea. But if only the don will do, try convincing one of the other two. That's why it's a Trio, and not just the me-oh. Now skedaddle.", "That kid's really something.", "So have half the people in this town. Anyway, we're both still alive. Call it?", "When I fall from grace, maybe I'll land in your parlor once more.", 'Hmph.', 'When you bet it all on a toss, sometimes you get burned by lady luck. Don't think you do.", "Howdy. Madam M said you'd be swinging by. Lemme see if I've got this straight. There's no denying you're skilled with a sword, but when it comes to damn near anything else, well... can't help but have my doubts. Ain't nothing wrong with that, but then there's nothing wrong with expanding your horizons neither. Seeking new experiences. Knowing the ways of this here world will help you to better protect her while you're in it. Reckon I've got a few solid gigs for you. Whaddya say? You game?", " That's the spirit. You have yourself a grand time tonight, mister merc.", "So, tell me. What'd you see in our little enclave of sin and debauchery? Bet it was an eye-opening experience.", 'Not exactly. I got one more favor to ask. You wanna get Tifa out, right?', "Heh, just get your ass to the colosseum. You'll see.", "Heh, just get your ass to the colosseum. You'll see.", "Nice going, champ. You were in fine form today. Here's your cut. You earned it.", "Ahh, Tifa... She's something of a bombshell herself, huh? Girl keeps in shape, and boy does it show.", "Just making an observation, that's all. Anyway, seems like you're serious about getting the poor girl out of her predicament. I could tell easy enough by the way you fought back there.", "Never said I would—opposite, even. Getting mixed up in other people's business isn't my way. Plus... As you are now, I reckon you could ride to her rescue without anybody's help. And that's the truth. You've changed since you first rolled into this here town. For the better.", "At any rate, I've said all I'm gonna say. Your lady friend oughta be done changing by now, am I right? She ain't no Tifa, but she is a firecracker. Keep her waiting too long and she might just blow up in your face.", "Can't say I ever understood the appeal of going to so much trouble to gussy yourself up.", "Wh... what's with the attitude?", 'Hey. Pretty crazy, huh? Can you believe this mess?', "I am, but I can't say the same 'bout my birds. Poor things're scared half to death.", "Gotta calm 'em down somehow.", 'Times like these, people are gonna need our help.', "Thanks for agreeing to find my birds. You're a real saint. Someone said they heard a chocobo warking in one of them Sector 5 back alleys. Heard there's a chocobo out by the collapsed expressway. A chocobo was spotted near the old church. That's about all that's reached my ears. I'd bet good money those wandering birds are mine.", "You don't think my missing birds're hurt, do ya?", "It's just plain senseless, that's what it is.", "There's the champ with a heard of gold! My babies are all back home, safe and sound. Now I can finally get back to the busienss of business. Thanks, partner. Here, y'all earned this. It's a pass that'll get you a ride on one of my carriages whenever you need it—free of charge, of course. Not bad, am I right?", "Chocobos're somethin' else. You can ride 'em, pet 'em, befriend 'em. What would we do without 'em? They're the reason a guy like me can keep a roof over his head in a town like this—and that's no lie. I wouldn't blame ya for doubting that coming from me, but it is what it is.", 'Anyhow, gotta make up for lost time.', "But hell, me and the birds've been through thick 'n' thin. We'll fiigure it out.", 'Question is, where to start.']

And you're in no state to fight anyway.", 'Shut up and move.', "The real challenge starts now. Okay. Let's go.", "Let's look for reception.", "You think everything's going too well?", 'This is Shinra HQ. The hell did you expect?', "Except that mako *has* made people's lives better.", 'No!', 'Sephiroth... ', "That wasn't just a movie.", 'So what does the mayor want with us?', "What the hell's going on?", "We're here to save a friend who was taken.", "But you're the mayor.", 'So, can you tell us anything about this collaborator?', 'Stay focused. We need to find this guy.', 'A plate did just fall.', "Let's find our contact.", 'Combat sim. You can use it to train for battle in a virtual space.', 'The mayor.', 'The mayor.', 'Never mind.', 'The mayor.', 'The mayor.', 'The mayor.', 'The mayor.', 'The mayor.', 'The mayor.', "We came to get one of our friends. She's being held in a research lab somewhere.", "We'll find a way in. Know where we can find Hojo?", "We need to find out what they're planning.", 'Thanks for the tip.', 'Yeah.', "I'm good. Let's keep moving.", "That's right. We only get one chance. Hojo should be at that board meeting, so that'll buy us some time. We need to plan this just right.", 'Little bit of recon. Need to find a way to infiltrate that room.', 'No, thanks. We can find it on our own.', "Tifa. It'd be better if you waited inside.", 'Gotcha.', 'On guard duty.', 'Yeah, sure. Just follow behind.', 'This it?', 'The man in the lab coat. Head of R&D. We follow him.', "Not until he's led us to Aerith. That's the plan.", "Let's go.", 'Aerith!', "We're taking Aerith back!", 'But will they get here in time to save you from me?', 'Yeah.', 'Barret!', 'Yep.', 'Save it for later!', "Let's get outta here.", 'Come on.', 'He got away.', 'Je... no... Oh... Ah... ', 'Mo... ther... ', 'Yeah. Where are we?', "... Aerith. Before we break outta here, talk to us. There's so much we don't know.", 'Aerith.', "Yeah, well, I'm glad he did.", "Someone's picking a fight.", 'Way ahead of you!', 'Cool.', 'So... what are you gonna do now?', "Let's go.", 'Tell me. Is it really you?', "I'd better hurry.", 'Test subject pods? Guess I can use these.', 'Thanks.', "Yeah. Where're the others?", "Let's go.", 'If we flip that switch, we can get to the other side.', 'You sure?', 'Need hand?', 'For how long?', "Yeah. I'm fine... ", "Guess we're out.", 'Yeah. You okay in there?', "You two'll be on your own. Be careful.", 'All right.', "All right. We'll make our way to the central terminal. Sit tight until you hear from us.", 'Tifa, you there? We accessed the central terminal. The door should be unlocked now.', "Any one of Hojo's twisted creations could be in that ward. Be careful.", 'Tifa?', "You two, stay there. We'll call if anything comes up.", "More of Hojo's experiments.", "Where's Hojo?", 'Forget about him for now.', "They're enhanced... or dissected.", "I'll let Tifa and Aerith know.", 'The passages have to be connected somehow.', 'Please.', 'Red!', 'Right. On it.', 'Tifa, you there?', 'Red fell to your level. Can you try to get to him?', 'That you?', 'Good. Glad to hear it.', 'Thanks. Wait for us there.', 'Guess so.', 'Maybe.', 'Well... that makes two of us.', 'Run!', 'Dammit!', 'Yeah.', "Let's go.", 'Huh?', "I'm ready to do this. I quit.', "Let's get this over with.", 'Think you got my number?', "That's a new trick.", "Now it's just the two of us.", "It's on for real now?", 'I could end this—here and now.', "Let's roll.", 'Yeah.', 'Time to go!', 'Heads up!', 'Get down!', 'You good?', 'Copy! Go for the head.', "The world won't end today. But you... You will.", 'Then why did you stop me?', 'Because of him? Sephiroth?', "You said it yourself. He has to be stopped. Take 'em down at the same time.", 'Bring it on, bitch!', "Let's do this.", 'Where are we?', 'Sephiroth... ', "Let's finish this.", 'Shut up!', "Don't know about need... Good to go?", "Not really.
