Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Ah, you wouldn't happen to be a certain merc that's become the talk of the town?", "I'm Damon. Little more than a humble reporter with the Daily Buzz.", 'On the contrary, my dear! We strive to raise awareness of the plight of our undercity brethren. We seek a better future for everyone, rich and poor.', 'Now then, my friends. I find myself in need of your exceptional services for a trifling matter. Are you familiar with the mysterious—and notorious—bandit known as the "Angel of the Slums"? She delivers written declarations to her victims—usually Shinra associates—before divesting them of their valuables.', "Yes. She's got a knack for public relations. Very popular down here as a result. Nevertheless, she is a criminal and a threat to the public order! I've made it my mission to unmask the villain, but the locals have been uncooperative and uncommunicative, to put it mildly. And now that my identity as a reporter has been exposed, my sources have all deserted me! Which brings me to you—the merc of the hour, and the man who will serve up my scoop!", "I'll welcome any and all information pertaining to the so-called Angel of the Slums.", 'So! Any news?', "Mireille as in *the* Mireille? The town gossip? I chased her for days, begging for info, but she wouldn't give up a single scrap! So how'd *you* get the old bird to talk?", 'Then quickly, before you have another, tell us: what do you know about the notorious Angel of the Slums? Has she struck again? Is that it!?', "Her base of operations? Now that's a scoop! Where is it!? Tell me!", "Lookout Point—got it! I'll check it out right now!", 'Er, well, uh... Well! A good reporter knows never to take foolish risks. "Plan first, then act." That\'s every respectable journalist\'s motto!', 'So, my good mercenary. If I might impose upon you again, it would be lovely if you investigated Lookout Point for me.', 'The forgotten Lookout Point deep within the scrap. Could it be that this place holds the secrets of the Angel? This is what we need to find out!', 'If you do happen to run afoul of any ravenous fiends, it would be lovely if you did something about it. For the truth!', "I promise I'll pay you once the job's complete. Just make sure you come back with good news—or any news!", "I can't believe it! You found one of her calling cards! This is the genuine article, I'm sure of it! Penned by the Angel herself!", "It's an incredible find! Oh—was that all?", 'Not just a message from the Angel... A warning!', "Now, now. No harm, no foul... right? In any case, I hope this narrowly averted tragedy won't discourage you from sharing information with me in the future.", "It's you, my good merc! What brilliant timing you have! Oh, hello there—it is a pleasure to meet you both. I'm a journalist for the Daily Buzz.", "Well, yes, that's fair—but we do get a lot of inside information because of our close ties with the company. (laughs) Curious? Here's the scoop. A certain division of Shinra—that shall remain nameless—was planning to seize Corneo's assets. But before they could, the key to his secret vault within which his misbegotten gains were securely tucked away... was stolen! And my sources tell me that the thief... is the undercity's beloved hero: the Angel of the Slums! The unidentified bandit who's been targeting anyone with ties to Shinra or Corneo! Yes, that Angel of the Slums has struck again! Well? Do I have your undivided attention now?", "Then I'll make this quick. So! My good merc. You do remember where the Angel's hideout is, right?", "Oh, that. I've decided to seek the silver lining in this case. If the Angel of the Slums deigns to taken an interest in a humble reporter, then that itself would be a story!", "If you recover the stolen key, feel free to help yourself to the contents of Corneo's vault. All I want is knowledge—the identity of the Angel. So if you happen to learn anything of value, I'd be tremendously grateful to you if you passed it along.", 'If you learn anything at all, I demand that you tell me!', "I'm dying to find out who the Angel of the Slums really is.", 'It is a desire that transcends the professional! Could it be... love?']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Ah! Wonderful! You finally made it. I am the mayor of the great metropolis of mako. Domino, at your service. (chuckles) I must say, you three haven't exactly been discreet. I wonder who's been cleaning up all your messes.", "Come on. Think about it. You've been caught by security several times... walked in front of every other camera... and scared an accountant half to death. Do you hear the alarm? No? You're weclome.", "I can only assume your cell wasn't looped in. I am Avalanche's man on the inside.", "Is it really that surprising to you? You've seen where they've put me. The mayor of the greatest city in the whole wide world... tucked away in a secret broom closet in the damned archives! The nerve. Those stupid Shinra pricks thought I'd just shut up and accept their treatment, but they were wrong! Dead wrong!", "What? Why? You mean you're not here to give President Shinra his comeuppance?", "Well, I don't particularly care what you end up doing—so long as it hurts Shinra.", 'So. I can get you as far as the 64th floor.', 'That is indeed the best that I can do.', '"But you\'re the mayor"!? Does this look like the office of a mayor? I\'m a glorified librarian—nothing more! They don\'t even invite me to their meetings! Sorting records and reports—that\'s all I do! My hands and fingers have more paper cuts than skin! No one knows my pain—my daily torment! They\'ve made me a pathetic shell of a man.', 'Hm. Let me see that keycard of yours.', 'Here you are. You can now use it to access the Recreational Facility on the 63rd floor.', 'Just say "mayor" to the guy, and if he goes "the best!" with gusto, then you\'ve found your man. You got it?', 'If you think you\'ve found the collaborator, say "mayor" and see if he says "the best!" You got it now?', "I've done everything I can for you. Now don't make me regret doing it!", 'Ah-ha! There you are!', 'What are you doing, man!?', 'This complicates matters. That explosion just now put the whole building on high alert.', "No need to panic, little lady. See? You can still move freely within Hojo's laboratory."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Ladies!', 'Nice. Very nice! Whichever one shall I pick?', 'Shall I pick you? Or maybe... you?', "Oh yeah! I've got it! I've got it! Today's bride-to-be is... ", 'Huh? Hey, which one of you said that? Was it you?', "Ohhh, you got a mouth on you! I'm gonna enjoy breaking it in! Today's lucky lady is the big-boned girl! (laughs) Still playing hard to get? I can dig it. Oh yeah.", 'The leftovers are all yours.', "Don't be shy, little kitten. Shimmy on over and give daddy some sugar! No need to play coy. Nobody here but you and me... ", "You're even cuter than I thought!", 'Don\'t you worry your pretty little head. Just a picture to preserve the moment! And to ensure you don\'t do anything *inappropriate* like say "No"... ', 'Oh! Praise me more!', " Don't stop! Tell me what a bad boy I am!", 'Hey! Who the hell gave you permission to do that!? One of you get in here and teach this bitch some manners!', 'What the—!?', "So you're a man, huh? What are you three up to?", "Huh? Dunno what you're talking about.", "Alright, alright! I'll talk! I'll talk! Some guy with a gun for an arm—I was paid to find him!", "I can't tell you that! They'd hunt me down like a dog!", 'It was the director of Public Security! Heidegger! It was Heidegger!', 'Some things are better left unsaid, ya know!?', ' Heh. Alright, you got me. I could never say no to a sexy girl. Since Avalanche blew up two reactors, Shinra\'s decided they ought to stamp them out, home base and all. And I mean "stamp out." By targeting the support pillar and blowing it up.', "Did I stutter? The plate will come crashing down! (mimes explosion noises) It'll be Sector 6 all over again. I'm sure you've been there and seen the wreckage for yourself. So you know exactly what Sector 7's gonna look like!", 'Before you do!', "Please! This won't take long!", 'As everyone knows, villains only divulge their plans in a certain situation. But what is that situation?', 'Not what we were looking for! But you can find it... in the sewers!', 'Ladies and gentlemen, we have ourselves a winner! You get an all-expenses-paid trip... to the sewers.', 'Close, but no cigar! Your parting gift... is in the sewers!', "Oh, I'm sorry! Time's up! The answer lies... in the sewers!", 'Hee hee hahaha! Enjoy the sights and smells!', 'Oho? Come alone?', 'Really? Without my little Avalanche kittens? I thought I told you to round them up and bring them to me.', "Leslie. I don't think I need to remind you why I'm down here. Spilling the beans to those three escape artists was a serious mistake. And now I'm on Shinra's shitlist! The plate stunt was meant to be an unprecedented tragedy claiming countless innocent lives... But those naughty little kittens organized an evacuation and screwed up the plan.", "I'll let you in on a secret. Shinra's going to abandon Midgar... and build something close to paradise. I was invited to be a part of it—don of a new and improved Wall Market. I'll be lucky to live another week. Leslie... I was gonna let you run your own place—give you a piece of the action. What a shame.", 'Pop quiz time, kiddo! Villains like us only divulge our evil plans... in a certain situation. But what is that situation, hm?', 'Goodbye.', "Oho! It's you!", 'Ahh! Over there! Over there, look!', "But that's the thing! It's not technically bullshit when it's true.", 'Good Abzu! Feel free to play with your food! Don out... ']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Take good care of her?', "Okay... But why not wait until tomorrow? If you head out now, it'll be dark when you get back. Better to rest up here and make the trip first thing in the morning. When you'll have daylight to spare.", "That Aerith... She's a handful, isn't she?", 'It must be tough— No, never mind.', 'Hmph.', "Where have you two been? I've been worried sick.", "Dinner's ready, in case you're wondering.", 'But before we sit down—I want you to make up the guest room.', "Judging by those eyes, I'm guessing you're a SOLDIER?", "I hate to ask... but would you leave here tonight? Without any fuss—no questions? You boys made a trade—a normal life for power. You can't have it both ways.", "Good. Now—I hope you're hungry.", "You're leaving.", "It's simple enough. Just cut through Sector 6. It isn't exactly safe, but you should be okay, seeing as you're a SOLDIER.", "Promise me. You'll never talk to Aerith again. Please.", 'Thank you.', "I'm sorry.", "She's sleeping upstairs.", "I said she's sleeping!", "Keep it down. Don't wake her.", 'Maybe you should join your friend upstairs.', "Keep it down. Don't wake her.", 'Shinra has my daughter now.', "It's not your fault. It was only a matter of time before she ended up back there.", 'So she told you about that? She must trust you all a great deal... ', "Yes. Aerith is an Ancient. Probably the last one living. She's not my daughter. Not by blood, I mean. If that's what you were wondering... ", "About fifteen years ago... My husband, he'd been shipped off to fight on the front lines. But then I received a letter saying he'd be home for a bit. So when the day came, I went to the station to meet him... But... he didn't come. I couldn't help fearing the worst, even then... but I told myself his leave must've been postponed, that he'd been delayed. Every day I went, to wait, and to pray... ", 'And that\'s how I met her. Her and her mother. I thought maybe they\'d run away from Wall Market. Or that they were topsiders fallen on hard times. I\'d seen that sort of thing a lot. "Take Aerith somewhere safe." Those were her mother\'s dying words. My husband had been away for so long, and I was lonely. So I convinced myself the safest place for the girl was with me.', "I didn't understand any of it at the time. When I asked if she meant one in the sky... She said no, this one. Right here. I mean... what can you say to that... ?", "That's what she said to me one day, out of the blue.", "I didn't believe her, of course. And then, a few days later, I received a letter saying my husband had been killed in action. Things like that, she'd just know. It was a lot to deal with, but we were happy. And then came the knock.", "But all three of us knew that wasn't true. That man knew exactly who Aerith was, where she'd come from, and what she could do.", "She had to come willingly, otherwise it wouldn't work, they said. That's why... even if they did take her away, I'm sure she's still being treated like a guest... And that they'll send her straight back home once they get what they need.", "You're not planning anything, are you? Don't make things worse than they already are. If I lost her too, I don't know if I could... if I could ever... Just don't.", 'Take care of yourselves now.', 'I would never leave a wounded man out on the street.', 'Not this again.', 'Enough!', "Please. I need some time to think. You've all had a long day. Why don't you go upstairs and get some rest.", 'Happy to help out however I can.', "... I've been thinking about what you said.", "I always knew it was coming. Knew that one day I'd have to say goodbye to my baby girl. But not yet. Please—bring her back to me.", 'Marlene!']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Seriously!?', 'Oh yeah? Go ahead!', "Tifa! You won't believe this! A cerulean drake flew in from the train graveyard, but these two clowns refuse to get off their butts and do anything about it!", "Hey... Is that... ? It is you! The new merc! Then maybe you can help us out? The drake is in the old Talagger factory over there, but to reach it you'll need to get ahold of a watch security key. You should be able to find one inside one of the crates—I forget which. Just smash 'em all.", "To reach the drake, you'll need to get past a locked door in the factory.", "There oughta be a key stashed inside one of the million crates in there. Keep smashing 'em until you find what you're looking for.", "So long as you can track down one of our security keys, access shouldn't be a problem.", "And there he is! I knew you were the right man for the job! There's no denying you're the real deal! Not like these idiots, with their excuses. Rather have one of you than twenty of them!", "What exactly is it you're trying to say, merc?", "I see now. Heard you were ex-Shinra. Guess I shouldn't be surprised you'd go to bat for your old buddies. Me, I'm just looking out for my people. All there is to it.", "Hell with you. We can take care of this town ourselves! No more mercs or Shinra—we'll build up the watch and kick you all out!", 'We don\'t want your so-called "protection"! We\'ll take care of ourselves!', "C'mon then, tough guy, do it!"]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Greetings and welcome. Avalanche, I presume? My name is Hart, and it's a pleasure to meet you. I've come to escort you to Mayor Domino, per his request.", 'Yes. The mayor of our dear Midgar... the most magnificent city ever built. That Mayor Domino. The Visual Entertainment Hall has been experiencing technical difficulties of late... and he suspected that these difficulties might impede your progress.', "I'm afraid you will have to ask him that yourself.", 'Through here.', 'The mayor is waiting.', 'If you require additional assistance, please do not hesitate to ask.', 'Certainly, I can do just that. But a man in my position must conduct his affairs with discretion. Which is to say that that which has been requested cannot be freely given... if you take my meaning.', 'Disclosing confidential information entails considerable risk. Due compensation is to be expected. In this particular instance, that would amount to ten thousand gil.', 'The 64th floor is reserved for our executives. The individual you seek is fastidious and well-dressed. This individual likes to visit the 63rd floor to decompress from the stress of the job.', 'Oh, are you dissatisfied with your purchase? How unfortunate. Perhaps this will help preserve our relationship.', 'An expression of my gratitude and appreciation.', 'If you require additional assistance, please do not hesitate to ask.']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['These sewer rats appear to call themselves Avalanche, sir. We are currently investigating whether they belong to the same group that made the attempt on your life. Rest assured, our inquiries will not take much longer.', 'Sir.', " Well done, well done! I felt sure we had them, didn't you?", "Born survivors, these sewer rats. Speaking of which, where's the third?", 'Return it to the wild.', 'You have nothing to worry about, sir. Preparations for the grand finale are proceeding without incident. I have the utmost confidence that everything will play out as you intended... ', 'Yes, of course. I will not fail you, sir.', ' Remind me what your job is. Is it to question the wisdom of your superiors and bemoan your personal hardships?', 'Casualty rate? You think I care about the casualty rate? They are pawns in a greater game. If your stock runs low, then go round up more for Sector 3 or wherever else. Use your head and bring me solutions instead of problems for a change, yes?', 'Report, report, report! What good do you think a damn report will do anyone!?', 'Have you already forgotten the war with Wutai? An enemy spared is an enemy who will repay your "kindness" with blood. We must crush them—thoroughly and completely, without hesitation or mercy! Shinra cannot and will not settle for anything less. Will you!?', 'If so... I can only assume that you and your men no longer wish to serve in your current positions. Is that correct?', "This won't do.", 'An "anomaly"? Or an excuse for your failure to properly prepare the armor?', 'Is that so?', "Yes... Yes... Everything is fine, sir. Better, even—there's been a development.", 'Yes... Understood, sir.', "We know exactly where they were headed. If the armor is intact, then you'd best determine the nature of this anomaly soon. Should you fail to do so... You will deal with our intruders. Personally.", "Don't worry. I treat my people more than fairly. So don't disappoint me.", 'Quickly now. Quickly!', ' Greetings, my dear sewer rats! As architect of our populace engagement campaign, I, Heidegger, head of Public Security... bid you welcome.', 'You should be flattered. Right now, you command the undivided attention of every soul in Midgar.', 'And so, to a people beset by chaos and uncertainty, we will offer the finest comfort: bread and circus!', "I'm on air!", 'To the imbecile in charge down there—you are hereby ordered to seize those intruders and bring them to me!', "Attention all security forces! I repeat—you are to bring the insurgents to the command center without further delay. What's Engineering's progress on getting that airbuster operational?", "... Still only sixty percent!? Bullshit! I swear, if you fail me, I'll throw you off the plate myself! So get it done already!", 'What is the status of my airbuster? Report!', ' As expected. Deploy it at once!', 'That was an order!', " You still don't understand your role in this.", "Don't you see? You fools were never in control. Never anything but pawns in our plans to sell great and glorious war to the people! And your instruments of insurrection will detonate—when we so choose!", 'Now let us raise the curtain on our main event! The trial of the eco-extremist group "Avalanche"! Terrorists who conspired with Wutai against Midgar! Your guilt is undeniable! Your punishment: death!', ' Sewer rats of Avalanche, pawns of Wutai! The people of Midgar will now see you for the cowards you are!', 'To fan the flames of hatred, you need a suitably spectacular display!', 'Now, let me hear you scream!', "You struggle in vain against the airbuster. Shinra's advanced weapons are unstoppable!", 'You sewer rats are truly pathetic!', "Yes, that's it! Very good. Now you will learn what happens to all those who oppose Shinra.", "Writhe and squirm for me! You didn't think your deaths would be quick, did you?", "Enjoying your time with Shinra's new weapon?", 'I have toyed with you three for long enough. Now I shall watch you die screaming!', 'This data will prove most useful!', "It's almost time for the grand finale! You will burn like the reactors you so hate!", 'Insolent fools! You brought this torment upon yourselves by opposing us!', 'How does it feel to hear your friends cry out in agony?', "Commencing phase two of the combat trial. You've seen but a fraction of this machine's true capabilities!", 'Tankbuster ready to fire! Now, show me how fast you can run!', "Your efforts are futile. It'll chase you to the edge of the world if need be.", "Hmph! I hope this isn't the end for you three. I was looking forward to a battle against worthy opponents.", 'Behold the full potential of the airbuster!', 'Time to carry out your executions!', 'And now for the grand finale! The tankbuster is ready to be deployed!', ' The Turks are on top of it. Yes, there will be no delays.', "The stench of the director's cowardice fills the room yet again.", 'Everyone here at Shinra is deeply saddened and outraged by this unconscionable act of terrorism. But at the same time, we will not be cowed by threats or violence. To the people of Midgar, I make this vow: we will find the villains responsible and bring them to justice. Are you listening, Avalanche—you cowardly dogs!? Run all you like. Shinra is coming.', "Rock solid. The people have embraced the Wutai-Avalanche conspiracy wholeheartedly. I've almost come to believe it myself.", 'So far, nothing. And if those cowards *do* react, all the better for us and our story.', 'If I may, sir, there was one other matter.', 'A message from our man Palmer.', "We don't have time for this nonsense!", 'Enough already! If there are intruders in the building, my men will deal with them.', 'My armory is at your disposal, should you require anything.', 'Yes... I can see that. It was only a matter of time. And here we are. (laughs) So then—what is this ragtag group of misfits I see before me?', 'And where are the rest of you?', "Hm. Charming. Though not what I would've chosen as my last words. Secure the Ancient, but feel free to kill both the idiot and the dog.", 'Goddammit!', "Stop, them you fools! Don't let them escape!", 'Mister Vice President.', ' The Turks are on top of it. Yes, there will be no delays.', "The stench of the director's cowardice fills the room yet again."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['There you are.', 'Sorry to make you come out here.', "Well then, I hope you won't mind me asking for some flowers.", "All you can carry. What with all the doom and gloom we've been hearing on the news recently, I thought some flowers might help cheer everyone up.", "Let's all wash up before our meal.", "Aerith, you're back. Come, look what we've done with the flowers. Lovely, don't you think?", "Isn't it?", 'Oh, I nearly forgot. I saw some Shinra suit walking towards your house a little while ago. He was dressed all in black. A little scary looking.', 'You alright?', 'If it isn\'t the new florist! I appreciate you helping the kids out today. Thank you. They won\'t stop talking about the SOLDIER who "saved the day." And make sure to give my thanks to Aerith too.', "The kids are talking about you like they've found themselves a new hero. Thank you for being there for the children. I really appreciate it.", 'Are you working at this hour?', "Don't push yourself too hard.", "Oh Cloud! Thank goodness you're here. A group of Corneo's men just came through—headed for Aerith's place.", "I don't know what business they have with Aerith, but I know it can't be anything good."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Here to work out? Put some muscle on that bony frame of yours?', 'You wanna go, do ya? All right then, bring it on!', "Bringing everything I've got.", 'No!', 'You did it, you really beat me. You gotta be in incredible shape!', 'You are in the zone!', 'Poetry in motion!', 'Slow and steady! One-two, one-two!', "I can't get enough of those beautiful muscles!", "You can do it, Jules! We're rooting for you!", "Who'da thought it'd be *this* close?", 'You got it, Jules!', "Andi hasn't slowed down or stopped.", 'Man, I can hear his lats screaming out in pain!', 'Here for a little training?', 'You wanna go, do ya? All right then, bring it on!', 'Those who sweat together get swole together!', 'True athletes need to be able to perform in cool and hot conditions!', 'Are you ready for this?', 'No!', 'You beat me fair and square. You really are a true champion!', "You've gotta give me another chance!"]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Have fun!', "So what's SOLDIER boy's deal? Is he one of us now? He's got balls, this, uh... Uh... what was his name again?", 'Right.', 'Real joy to look at too.', 'Looks are what people notice first.', "I'd say you're not even reading the same book.", "C'mon, Cloud!", "Don't you worry. Biggs'll have the door open soon.", "We're back!", 'He always knows just what to say!', "It's a good thing I know someone who can get us the passcodes. Pity no one else at command will talk to us, but what can you do? And we're good!", "Looks like the elevator's on another floor. Mind pushing that button?", "So... you know Tifa, right? It's not really my business, but are you guys *close*?", "Well, so much for having Cloud do all the fighting. There are some places a sword just can't reach... Just... bear with him for me, would you?", 'Look what we have here.', "Those things'll hurt more than your pride if you're careless. They'll cut you down to size and then some. ... But I'm guessing you've done this kind of thing before.", "Exactly! I'll go first. Nothing like a little danger to get the blood pumping.", 'Just keep those baby blues of yours on me!', 'You okay!?', 'Pay more attention.', 'Just relax.', 'Keep your cool.', " Sorry, couldn't help myself.", "You SOLDIERs sure can take a beating. Still kickin', I see.", 'Are you *trying* to get hit?', 'You sure you were a SOLDIER?', ' I had no idea you were such a klutz.', 'Um, you have a fetish or something?', "There's a fine line between being daring and being dumb. Food for thought.", "Huh. He's a natural!", 'Not too shabby.', "You're doing good, SOLDIER!", "Okay, let's see what's up next!", "... And it's more of the same. Come on, then.", 'Pretty easy, right?', 'Nice job, Cloud!', 'Like a walk in the park, huh?', 'Not a scratch! Now onto the objective!', "Well, I'm glad that's over with. And we're almost at our objective.", "Look. They don't call those things sweepers for nothing. They can wipe out a whole squad in seconds.", "And that's that!", "That's our target. The reactor core. Gotta set the bomb at the bottom.", "Let's get down there.", "Heads up, boys—the end's in sight. I leave the rest in your capable hands. Good luck!", 'Not that way! Down the ladder, dummy!', "Aw, you're choosing me over the reactor? That's sweet, but I'll wait my turn. Go blow her mind.", 'Go on. Shoo.', 'Do I look okay!? Help a girl out, would ya!?', 'My hero!', 'Come this way! This route should lead us straight to Barret! Probably!', 'I think I see an exit. Come on!', "Don't look back! Let's go, let's go, let's go!", "We're running out of time!", "Sorry, it just— It keeps me focused! I'll freak out if I don't talk!", "Door's open!", "We don't have a lot of time here! Pick up the pace, people!", "If I couldn't, believe me, you'd be the first to know.", 'Cloud!', 'Okay, *that* was pretty cool.', 'All right. Come on!', 'I followed the instructions to the letter. Maybe it triggered a reaction with the mako?', "After all that, it better have. Anyway, let's get going. We in Sector 8?", 'Was it the mako density? The primary explosive? The blasting agent?', 'How much farther do we have to go?', "Stand back then. I'll set the bomb.", "She's good to go.", 'Fire in the hole!', 'Let that be a lesson to anything that gets in my way!', 'No... No way.', 'Yoo-hoo.', "I don't need to tell you what this is, right?", 'You can have it. For saving my life.', "Yeah, yeah... Fact is, I'm lucky you were there.", 'Words to live by!', 'You do know how to use it, right?', 'Okay! I was only trying to help.', "Oh—before I forget, here's a little something extra, for being so brave. That really was the ride of a lifetime... Well, see you on the train!", 'Cloud! Up here! Look up! I said look *up*!', 'I said look *up*!', "I give up. If you ever get up here, just be careful you don't fall, okay?", "Careful up here! This could collapse at any moment! If you want up, you'll have to use those stairs!", "Mmm, you think he's a keeper?", 'Nicely done.', 'A new Shinra weapon, maybe?', 'And in the freight car, too... ', 'Little help, Cloud? Please?', "I can't stop thinking about it. The bomb I made shouldn't have produced an explosion that big. It doesn't make any sense... ", 'That was my first guess—but shouldn\'t a reactor have fail—safes to prevent that kinda thing? You mentioned "invisible enemies" back there, right?', "Hmm... No. I'm just looking for excuses for something that was clearly my own fault. Gotta own up to it if I'm gonna learn from this and move on. Thanks, Cloud. You're a good listener.", 'Cloud! Over here.', "Let's get this out of the way... Personally, I find visual aids make the dull stuff a lot more bearable. If it helps, think of it as an initiation rite.", "Shh. There's such a thing as playing too hard to get.", "So, here we've got a wireframe model of the great city of Midgar. Complete with massive steel plates suspended three hundred meters above ground level... Atop which stands a shining beacon of civilization. The whole system is sustained by the mako reactors, which feed the insatiable appetites of the public.", "This here is the train's route. As you can see, it'll take us around this main pillar. Look—we're about halfway through it now. They've set up a checkpoint here to scan the IDs of all passengers heading in and out. Date of birth, residential status, criminal history... All that and more is automatically cross-referenced in their databases. Public Security wouldn't have it any other way. Heads up.", "Don't worry. Our IDs are impeccable.", "What'd I tell you? Have a little faith.", "Won't be long till we reach the bottom. Relax.", 'Woohoo!', 'Hell yeah!', 'I dunno. Figure out how I screwed up?', 'Hey! You see the news? "The reactor bombing was the work of the eco-extremist group \'Avalanche.\'" Public enemy number one! Gets your heart racing, doesn\'t it? They don\'t know our faces, so we\'re in the clear for now, but we\'ll wanna capitalize on this momentum. Speaking of which, you coming on the next one?', "Oh, you can bet I'll be pushing hard for a raise!", "Tifa'll be joining us too, but I dunno... Even a blind man can see her heart's not in it. She was never on board with the bombings, so if it comes down to do or die... If I've got to put my life in someone else's hands... Then... I'd rather that someone was a professional. Like you.", "Sorry, I tried. We talked it over, but... in the end... We didn't want to put so much on you. This is our fight.", 'Be right there!', 'No hard feelings, huh?', "Let's talk more after I'm done here, okay?", "I'll catch you later.", 'Sorry to keep you thirsty boys waiting!', 'Avalanche!', 'Damn, Biggs, slow down!', 'They did not "give us the boot"!', "Just thinking about it's making me mad again.", "Tifa's got you covered there.", "As if you've really gotta ask!", 'Avalanche!', 'We were all pushing real hard for you, you know.', "But he was afraid we'd lean on you too much if we took you along.", "We'll talk.", 'Welcome home, honey! Took your sweet time.', 'Psych.', 'Are you gonna let me in so we can talk in private?', "Guess I'll get right to the point, then.", 'An apology. For not getting you on the mission. Or not. What do *you* think it is?', "Nailed it in one. Gonna have to ask you to keep all this a secret from the others, though. It's a personal matter—something I need to sort out tonight.", "Tonight. You and me, together. I want you to come with me to the Sector 7 plate. I'll give you the details on the way.", "I do, but... If I don't deal with this now, it's only gonna get harder... Anyway... I can count on you, can't I?", 'A down payment.', "Doubt we'll be back before morning—'case you were planning on traveling light. Make sure you've got everything you need before we leave. I'll wait here.", 'You all set?', 'Take all the time you need. Nothing a woman likes more than being kept waiting. But seriously, get your ass in gear already!', "Awesome. Meet me at the station before dark. Don't be late!", 'How did you guess... ?', "All right, I'll give you that—but how did you know I wanted to head topside? Was I talking in my sleep? What else did I say!?", 'Yup. Right on the head.', 'Are your parents still around?', "Okay, then. Guess you're all invited! Here's to awkward family reunions!", 'I take it you boys have your brand-spanking-new IDs?', "Then let's lay down some rubber!", 'You hear me?', "Just so you know, I'm not going plateside for the reason they think I am. Look—you saw the way the reactor went up. It was huge, right?", 'Yeah... that was wishful thinking. Deep down, I know it was my fault. I used a more powerful blasting agent than the directions called for. It had nothing to do with the mako.', "I'm planning on using a weaker blasting agent this time. But... since I can't get in touch with my supplier, our only option is to loot a warehouse owned by Shinra.", "With your help, we won't need luck.", 'ID scan! Ready!?', 'Alright, here comes the hard part!', 'The fake IDs may have held up, but from this point on, if we get pinged by a scan... ', 'Yeah, what he said.', "No need to worry. We've got Cloud, remember?", 'Hey, you do know how to drive, right?', 'Well then! You gonna take my breath away? Make my head spin with your amazing skills?', 'Right... ', 'That some super-secret technique? You got a fancy name for it?', "We've got company!", 'Oh! My hero!', "What, so you'd just pull over if they asked nicely?", "See!? So don't go holding back now!", "I won't forget that. (laughs) Wait, is it just me or did we slow down?", "Think we've bitten off more than we can chew! Whadda we do!?", "Uhh, I don't like the sound of that!", "Head's up—drones!", "You're damn right you do!", 'No, head straight for the warehouse. Awww... Our magical ride is almost at an end... ', "Because you're not!", "What's going on?", "Who's that?", "What's this guy's deal!?", 'Heard *that*, huh!?', 'This guy is the worst.', 'What is he up to now?', "Don't get too excited. Reinforcements are hot on our trail.", 'You failed the test.', 'Driving.', 'Hah! Great at scaring your passengers, more like... ', 'Maybe you should just let *me* drive.', "Gues I'll take one for the team and be your back warmer again.", 'You passed the test!', 'Driving.', "Not really. You made it by the skin of your teeth, if we're being honest.", 'I bet you held back because I was with you.', "So now I'm too weak to stay on a bike? Huh? Huh?", 'I might... be falling after all.', 'Psych!', 'You passed the test!', 'Driving.', "So you don't need a reward?", 'Well, you got one anyway.', "You can thank me later. I'll wait.", 'Giving me the cold shoulder?', "Aw, would you look at that... It's the end of the ride.", "We'll go on foot from here. Don't wanna draw too much attention to ourselves.", "Don't worry, we'll top you up soon enough. Now let's roll.", 'Hey! Focus!', "The residential area's just beyond this gate. Mind doing the honors?", "You've got an arm on ya!", 'Here we are—the employee housing district. Where they put you when your parents work for Shinra. While their reactors were slowly killing the planet, we were living the good life... ', "Figures. Still leaves the lights on every night for the girl who only comes home once every other blue moon. Mom's an old-fashioned type like that.", 'And she loves guests who ask for seconds or thirds.', "Okay, let's head in. Cloud—you know what to do. Why don't you wait around the corner over there?", "With your help, we won't need luck. You'll take on just about any job, right? Well, I need you to rob my house. Think you can do that for me?", 'Go in through the back door when the coast is clear. The signal will be obvious.', "Inside, you'll find a room with two doors. Don't take the one in front of you. You want the room on the right. That's where you'll find it.", 'Sorry about dropping in like this again.', "We'll be chatting Mom up in the kitchen, so don't even bother being quiet. There's no way she'll ever hear you. Dad'll be in there, but it's okay.", "I need you to grab his Shinra ID card. And yeah, I know I should do it myself, but... (chuckles) but I honestly don't think I'm up to it. Just do this for me, okay?", "Now this—this is what I've been waiting for!", 'Alright, here comes a Midgar Special!', "Dang, Mom, how'd you get even better at this?", "Wedge, don't hurt yourself!", 'My dad—he was a maintenance supervisor at the reactor.', "Uhhh, I'll think about it. You know, I'd really love to stay and chat, but we gotta go.", "Yeah, well, we hadn't even planned on dropping by. But Wedge wanted some of your famous pizza.", 'Wedge!', "I'm planning on using a weaker blasting agent this time. Since I can't in touch with my supplier, our only option is to loot a warehouse owned by Shinra.", 'Hey there.', "Now comes the hard part. I'm gonna use this to sneak into the 7-6 Annex.", "Sorry, but you're staying outside. Only I know what to steal from where, so it's gotta be me who goes in.", " You think I'd let you off that easy? You're gonna earn every slice helping Cloud. Just do the thing where you draw everyone's attention away, like you did at my parents'. What's the word again? Maybe I'm more nervous than I thought.", 'Yeah, that! Nice one, military man.', "Exactly. Couldn't've put it any better. When you see a flare go up, that's your cue. Rush the front gates and make for the warehouse plaza. The more hell you raise, the more time you buy me.", "Not too much. I'll be in and out. I'll send up another flare when I'm done. We rendezvous in the vacant lot up ahead.", "No, I wanna be back before that. Don't worry, I have something worked out. Now, let's get this done.", 'You made it! Over here!', "Could you have been any louder? I mean, it made my job a lot easier, but— Wait, where's Wedge?", 'Wedge!? That was close... ', "Are we seriously doing this here? That's... wow.", 'Your ass is fine. Maybe singed, but the only casualty is your underwear. This is like a bruise or a mild burn at worst!', 'Is that a smile I spy?', 'Copy that!', "With a little trick I've been dying to try out... ", "Right, this is it! Through here and we're home free.", "When we get there, you'll know! Now that I've got my blasting agent, we should have everything we need for our next mission!", 'Huh?', 'Really, huh? *Cloud* said that?', "Really... ? Well, okay then! Maybe I'll lend Mom a hand next time too!", "Should be somewhere around here... Bingo! I half figured my dad got it wrong, but nope! They're here just like he said!", 'Fifty-fifty is pretty good odds, if you ask me! This is gonna be fun!', "Thanks guys. I really appreciate you coming all this way with me. And like I said before, I'd be grateful if you kept this between us until after the mission. I don't wanna... complicate things.", 'Me! Me!', 'Wait, I almost forgot! One more thing!', "Easy! You'll make us fall!", ' Now more than ever!', 'Yeah! Together we can take on the world!', 'Well, if it isn\'t Cloud Strife! Was wondering when you\'d show up. Without further ado... Here you are. Thanks for stepping up, "merc." And now for the cherry on top.', 'Depends. Mind coming over tomorrow night? My roommates should all be out for a while.', 'Only if you promise to come back tomorrow night. Deal?', "Really? You will!? I make a mean pizza, I'll have you know! Marche, luche, black milly, red shelly—I use only the best ingredients! Sound good?", "Awww, you are *so* adorable, you know that!? You just leave everything to me—it'll be great!", "Ah, sorry... Little too in-your-face? I'll just have to change it up then.", ' Nighty night!', 'Psych!', 'Barret!', "They just keep coming! We've gotta do something!", 'Leave us alone already!', 'How many of them are there!?', 'Shit!', 'Me and my two left feet... ', 'God, this is so embarrassing... Hate playing the damsel in distress... ', "Not nearly as much as the fuss everyone's making.", "I'm fine!", "Huh? What about the mission? We already sent Biggs in, remember? Don't tell me you're thinking of calling it off!?", 'The hell you do!', 'Go and raise some hell for me, okay?', "Relegated to stagehand once again. I'm starting to think I'll never have a starring role... ", "What's this? Words of encouragement? (chuckles) Thanks, I need them.", "Hurry back now. You don't want my home-cooked pizza to get cold.", "If I didn't know any better, I'd swear those robed things were after *me*. Be careful out there.", "Once the mission's over, you've gotta celebrate with us, alright?", "Don't be a hero, okay? Just get the job done.", "So, how'd you guys rate my latest and greatest design? Eleven outta ten?", "Today's your unlucky day, 'cause I never miss.", 'Oh, jeez... Tifa... If you could see the look on your face... ', "So... you're the guy... who gets to hear my last words... Heh... Lucky me.", "It's okay, Cloud... It's okay. They were my bombs. They were all... my victims. I had it... coming.", 'My hero. So gentle... ', " So dramatic... I... I just wish that... I could've had you over again... Everyone... With Mom's cooking... I really wanted... to believe... we could... ", " That's right. I do. But... I don't think... ", "Oh no... Tifa's crying. Did I say something wrong?", "Don't you guys... have somewhere to be? It's not polite... to stare... you know... ", "I don't get it. The mission was a success. So why aren't they back yet?", "Shame, since you won't be getting any.", 'Enough already, Shinra. We get it.', "I should be up there with them... Not that I'd be much use, but still... ", "Where are they? They should've been here by now... ", 'As if! Wait, who are you?', "Don't mean to be rude or anything, kid, but do you mind? I'm not exactly in the mood.", 'Not in the mood. Go bug literally anyone else.', "You gotta be—Didn't I tell you I'm not in the mood?", ' You know what? Fine, why the hell not. Might help take my mind off things.', "Damn... Well, can't win 'em all.", 'Ha ha, laugh it up. Now leave me alone, wouldja?', 'Keep pushing me... ']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Stay away from me!', "Get off me, assholes! I didn't do shit!", 'Or what!? Screw you!', ' What the hell, man!? You trying to break my arm!? Dragging me through the street like this is—ow—cruel and unusual punishment!', 'Come on, guys! Is this any way to treat a model citizen of Midgar?', "Huh? You've got it all wrong! I've never gone anywhere near a Shinra warehouse! Unless it was Jessie... She jacked my ID!", "What!? That's bullshit! Cheap bullshit! Entrapment! Yeah, yeah! I know my rights!", "Uh... so... is it over? Yo, anybody there? If you're there, then help me!", "Huh!? You're not gonna... Hold up! Wait! Don't—don't do it, man!", "Y-y-you got it, boss! You ain't never gonna see my face again, I swear!", "Warmth, relaxation, the sweet embrace of pretty ladies! That's what I need!", "To enter, or not to enter. *That* is the question. Wherefore does this philosophical quandary torment me!? You totally get where I'm coming from, right?", "Hah! I *knew* it! Let me guess—after you've had your fun, you fall into a spiral of shame and self-loathing. But it only lasts a moment, doesn't it? Next thing you know, you're right back here again... Huh? Gotta question for me?", "Yeah, I should've figured. You're not the philosophical introspective type like me. That soft, naive face. I know your kind well, bro. You're just another musclehead who uses violence to work through your inner demons. It's sad, really. Huh? Yeah, what's up?", "Tifa? My love, my light!? Who are you, and how do you know her!? No, shut up. I don't care! Tifa's here? Why!? Tell me why! Oh god, no. I did this to her, didn't I. She came looking for me, to beg me not to leave her! Snap out of it, Johnny. Your Tifa needs you! Tifa—I'm coming, baby!", "So that's the way it is, hmmm? Tifa's been invited invited into the don's estate... ", "But! To earn such a privilege, you must first win the approval of one of the Trio. Right? Meaning! I now know what I must do to save her! Stay strong, Tifa! Help is on the way! Johnny's comin', baby!", 'What were you thinking!? Stupid, stupid, stupid! Crawl into a hole and die!', "You should've known better. Always go with your gut!", 'Shoulda said heads... ', "Damn, man... It wasn't supposed to go down like this. I-I just wanted to see Andrea. Curse my weak will... But... It was like whoa... ", 'I mean, shit... ', "The hell is this bullshit? I ain't payin' that much!", "Ol' Johnny's been had. She's a siren, I tell you... ", 'My gil... ', 'Oh... You again.', "I just needed a little scratch, you know? So I signed up for the preliminaries, and well... I hope you guys realize what you're getting into. I don't wanna scare you but if you can make a run for it, you should.", 'Never been more scared in my entire life.', "It's a gift from Don Corneo. Drink it, and they say you'll be raring to go for hours on end. If I had, maybe things would've gone differently for me. Maybe you should. It's yours if you want.", "Wait up, Cloud! Sam caught me up on everything. He said you're gonna go rescue Tifa. And to do that, you're trying to learn all about Wall Market. Bro, I know this town like the back of my hand, so I can answer all of your questions! Now, let's go knock this one out! The bar's this way, Cloud.", "Drunkards', here we go!", 'Uh, are we even allowed to walk through the door? I\'m getting a "regulars only" kinda vibe.', 'Hey! Old dude!', "Wha—? Well, right back at ya! Ugh, whatever. We're here to take you back to the store.", "Come on, there's no need to talk like that, old dude! I'll help you out with whatever you need!", 'Your precious inspir-who with the what now?', "Got it! I mean, I don't got it, but... I just need to get your inspiration back, right? Whatever the hell that is. Leave it to me, old dude!", "I've never actually been inside, now that I think about it.", "I don't even really know how people use materia. They're just, like, huge orbs of... something.", "This place looks kinda creepy, don't you think? Like maybe they practice ritual sacrifice or... ", 'Hey, wait for me!', 'Sooo... this is it, huh?', 'I\'m here for the "precious inspiration" you took from the old dude.', "Well, that's true!", '... Whatcha need?', "No, I don't think I... Wait. The Sauce!", 'The time has come... for me to wield my powers of assessment!', "Huh!? No no no, we're not here for that!", 'I wish I was here with Tifa. No offense, bro.', "That's it. That's the one! It looks like a regular old vending machine, right? But wait! You ready for this? All right. This particular model has secret buttons.", "Well... I can't tell you—it's a secret! You just need to tap into your knowledge and expertise—like, grab it and whip it out! And then you'll be able to see everything?", 'Whoa, look at you, bro!', 'Huh? Is this the Sauce? I dunno... Come on, bro! You know there are more hidden buttons waiting to be pushed!', "Oh... So this is the Sauce. Neato... It-it's time. The last button... ", 'The Sauce! P-put it away! Put it away before someone sees you! No one can know that we have it!', " Don't scare me like that! Whatever! We got what we came here for. Let's get outta here and head to the materia guy!", 'Uh, is it me, or is everyone looking at us... ? So this is what it feels like to be a champ.', "Come on, bro! Hurry up! Let's show him what we brought back from our little trip into the weird!", "It's time, bro! The Sauce.", "Damn, bro! That's why you're such an awesome dude!", "You shittin' me!?", "Ugh... Well, I guess we know where we're headed next. Come on, bro!", "Restaurant up next, huh? Getting kinda hungry, actually. Do you smell that? I think it's coming from over there.", "Let's see what's on the menu today. Meat, fish, and... ooh, that special looks good.", "Man, I like seriously don't know which one to get! I'm a decisive, but when it comes to food, it's a different story.", "Hey, wait for me! I still don't know what I wanna order yet!", "Sorry, we're not here to eat. The materia guy gave you something, yeah? We want it.", 'Nope. Never cooked once.', 'Man, I seriously have no idea what it could be. This sucks.', "You know... your fridge might be broken. Maybe it's not keeping the ingredients cold enough.", 'Man, this looks great!', "I can't... ", "Drugs... I need all the drugs right now! Outta the way! Outta the goddamn way! N-no... Can't go... ", 'Goodbye, cruel world... ', 'Sanctuary... ', "I'm gonna hurl... ", "Can't... go on... ", "And then there was this crazy-looking house, right? And it was all like trying to kill 'em! But then Cloud was all like bing, bang, boom!", 'Oh, hey! Welcome back, bro.', 'What is it?', 'Wait, we have? Hold up. What were we doing before all this? Oh shit! The inspiration!', "Holy mother of... No way! Bro! We gotta get to the Honey—er, um, I mean Drunkards' on the double!", "C'mon, bro. Get a move on!", "C'mon, c'mon, c'mon! I gotta know!", "You still got the inspiration, right? You didn't lose it!?", "My heart is beating so fast, bro. Like it's gonna burst right outta my chest!", "Hey, old dude. We're back!", 'Special delivery—just for you.', 'Yo, is that... what I think it is... ?', 'I knew it!', "Lead the way, old dude. We are comin'!", "Hey, how's about this?", "Hey—you're coming, right bro? Get ready for a *real* Wall Market education!", "I get it, bro. You're scared. It's only natural for people to fear the unknown. It's a pity you're not gonna join us, but I swear to you, bro, as an aspiring Wall Market connoisseur... I'm gonna go in there and get as much inspiration as I can handle. For you, bro! For you! Because Cloud—you are my one true bro. Honeybee Inn, here I come!", "Hey, how's about this?", 'Hot damn, old dude. Y-you made this one, too?', "Yessir! I'll be your most loyal pupil, I swear it!", "This silky one over here's kinda nice, too!", 'Nooo!', "I heard Corneo was gonna audition new girls soon, and Tifa's... Tifa's gonna be— I just... I-I don't know what to do.", "I'll come too!", 'Hey Cloud! Bro! I can call you bro, right?', "Just wanna say, bro, that I'm totally relieved that you're looking out for Tifa. So like, how'd you get so strong anyway, bro?", 'The way you fight, bro, is like poetry and violence! "Bam! Bam! Whoosh whoosh!" You know? I really wish I could be just like you. My problem is that I tend to overthink and overanalyze everything. So—bro, do you have any advice for a smart, stand-up guy like myself?', "Well, this is it for me. Call me crazy, but... I have a feeling that I'll just be getting in the way.", 'Yessir!', "Hey, get outta the way! Quit gawking! Move it, move it! C'mon! Yo, clear the road!", "Ma'am.", "Bro, look at you. So... how's the dress workin' out for ya? I wanted to help out. Do my part, you know? After Andrea told me the plan, I ran all over looking for... something. But, like, I don't got a lotta money... ", "Don't worry bro. You got this!", 'What were you thinking!? Stupid, stupid, stupid! Crawl into a hole and die!', 'Bro! Tifa! Damn, is it good to see you guys again.', "Bro. I'm in serious need of your expertise. Lend me a hand!", "Truth is, I'm, uh, trying to get outta town, for, uh, reasons. Yeah, reasons. But the thing is... (cries) I got mugged! She took it. Took it all, man! I tried to chase her down, I really did! But she was real fast-like. Man, what I am gonna do? This could be the end for ol' Johnny boy! I'm beggin' ya—help me out! Come on, bro!", "Bro! Uh, hold on. Lemme think—wanna get this right. She was a cutie. Black hair. Pretty sure she was wearin' a hat. And... oh yeah! She was wearing these striped stockings too.", 'Uh, toward the church I think.', 'Looked like she was hurt real bad, so I stopped to help.', 'And this is the thanks I get!', 'Bro! Do me a solid. Get my money back!', 'My wallet! My precious wallet! You really did it, bro! I knew I could count on you.', 'Thank you. Now I can get outta town.', "Hush, Tifa. Don't try to stop me. I'm a wanted man in these parts. If I stayed I'd be a danger to you too.", 'Oh, er... okay.', "Uh, yeah... hell yeah, I am! I'm your Johnny, Tifa. And nothing's gonna bring me down! Bro, Tifa, keep on shinin'. Johnny out!", 'Ugh. Great work, Johnny. Just great. Where you gonna find enough money at this short notice?', "Ah! Don't freakin' scare me like that! I'm highly strung! You trying to kill me or—Huh? Who the hell are you?", "Say what!? *Me*!? Nuh-uh! I was just... y'know... thinkin' about stuff. Huh? Hmm... (chuckles) Yeah, like how to bag that sweet, sweet Fort Condor prize money! It's my ticket outta here!", "Wha—Over my dead body you will! My life's on the line here! I deserve to eat! I deserve to live!", "What!? No, this can't be—Say it ain't so! Goodbye fortune... Goodbye pride!", "Huh? Wait, what'd you say?"]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["You know, I've heard from more than a few people that my son, Johnny, has been roaming the streets of Wall Market. Before he leaves town, I need to make sure I deliver him his lucky pillow. I have faith in my boy, of course. But a growing man needs plenty of sleep—sleep of good quality, no less. That's how mind and body stay healthy and active. In other words, this pillow is crucial to his health.", "My wife is back in Sector 7. I thought it best she wait for me there because the establishments in this town are, uh, provocative. Of course, I haven't been to any myself so I don't know what goes on around here. Not in the slightest.", "Wall Market really is one helluva town, isn't it? I'm sure my son Johnny learned a lot of lessons about life right here. The hard way, of course. Oh, my beautiful boy! As your father, and as someone who's been where you are, I look forward to seeing the man you become.", "I heard there was some sort of tournament going on. That must be why it's so crowded. It almost made me miss a chance to get a ticket to my favorite place. What's that? Oh, I could never tell!", "I tell you, I'm exhausted from all the fun and excitement of that tournament. I'll look for my son tomorrow. For now, though. I really should get some rest. And what's rest without a little relaxation for the body, mind, and soul? Fortunately I'm in the right place for that... ", "Hmm... It's a circle.", "Huh? Who's there? Eh, whatever... I'm havin' trouble seein' straight. What's the answer?", "Ya did it, boyo! I'm so damn proyd of ya.", "Man... You know what? You're useless... ", 'Oh, I getcha. Ya wanna go for round two!', "Huh? You're still here? But... why... ?"]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Cloud! Been waitin' for you to show up. Thanks for coming, and welcome to our humble training hall. Jules—head trainer. If you've got some time to spare, how about a little bit of fun? Wanna try taking on one of our guys?", "Now, now—I wouldn't judge this one by his muscle mass. What do you say, Cloud? If you wanna give it a go, just let me know.", 'So? You up for a round?', "All right, enough talk. We'll settle this the tried-and-true traditional way: a squat-off. Now, let's all see what you've got.", 'I knew you could do it!', "That's how it's done!", 'Not bad at all.', "Your form's looking good!", "You've got this! Come on!", "Now don't forget to breathe.", "Ronnie—you know it's all about quality, not mass. You're too quick to judge people by their build. That, and your overtrained ego are the main reasons you lost to our bold challenger here!", "Thanks for helping me teach my boys a valuable lesson. And sorry for dragging you into it. Cloud, we're all one big family here at this gym, and now you're part of it. If you're ever up for training, our doors are always open to you. Let's work together to maintain healthy minds *and* bodies.", "If you're ever in the mood for another workout, just talk to Jay or Ronnie.", " It's unfair that you guys are having all the fun. What do you say? May I have this squat?", ' You up for some exercise?', "Let's you and me work up a sweat.", "I'll never say no to a friendly competition.", "I won't go easy on you.", "You gotta loosen up. You're way too tense.", "I had no idea how strong you really were. You truly are something, aren't you?", "Listen up, everyone. We can be stronger, better. Let's hit those weights!", "Came running when I heard you were putting on a show. I didn't know you were such an amazing dancer! I wouldn't recommend lifting in that outfit, but if you need to work up a sweat later, feel free to pop into the gym!", "It's been hours now—don't you think you've done enough? Believe me, I ought to know.", "Looking for Andi? You found him/ He's been at it half the day.", "Not sure what's gotten into him.", "Excuse me. You're Tifa, right? While you're here, wanna give Andi a run for his money? Work up a sweat, release some endorphins. It's the answer to everything. I promise.", "There's always time for training.", 'Hm? Are you here for a workout?', ' You up for some exercise?', "Let's you and me work up a sweat.", "I'll never say no to a friendly competition.", "Okay—let's have some fun!", 'You know where to find me for a rematch.', "Couldn't keep up with you. Even as a trainer, I still have a lot to learn.", "I couldn't have asked for a better opponent."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Got new numbers for monsters slain this month! Check 'em out!", 'The tally of monsters slain has been updated!', "It's you! You're the merc everybody's talking about, am I right?", "I *knew* it! So, the board here tracks how many monsters folks've taken down, right? A bigger number means a safer town—and who wouldn't want that? Just between you and me, though—they're pretty much all *your* kills. Cool, huh? Anyway, keep up the good work! We'll try to make it worth your while.", "C'mon you guys! Let's get these numbers up!", 'Can you believe how much safer our town has become!?', "I sure do love the smell of safety, don't you!?", "Whoa, check it out! I don't think the number's ever gone that high before! At this rate, we won't have to worry about monsters ever again! What a thing to be able to say... ", "Thank you so, so much! We'll never forget how many bloodthirsty beasts you kept off our streets! Ahhh, smell that fresh air! That's the smell of a safe and happy town—one you can be proud to call home!", "Hey there, how's it going? I don't think anyone's ever gonna beat that record of yours! It's incredible!"]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['In the paradise of debauchery and sin—of pain and pleasure!', 'To you esteemed connoisseurs of chaos and bloodshed—we bid you the warmest of welcomes!', "Tonight's grand prize is no less than one million gil! And there is only one way to get it: brutalize your opponent!", 'Viciously!', 'Until they vomit blood!', 'And now, the long-awaited event in which the blood-starved beasts will battle for your amusement is upon us!', 'Talk about a bad date!', 'A bad first date!', 'Booo! Get lost! Go home! You suck!', "Their opponent—one of Wall Market's own, a renowned master of beasts! Will his pets make a meal of our two challenges before our very eyes?", 'Their hunger for flesh and fear is unquenchable—the demon dogs of hell, the Sanguine Stalkers!', 'What a completely unexpected turn of events!', 'More like "unlucky" for the rest of us!', 'Their opponents—reavers of the scrapyard, thieves and killers through and through! Too criminal for common criminals—the worst of the worst!', "The most contemptible sons of bitches this side of Wall Market—Beck's Badasses!", "It would seem that there are actually eight members of Beck's Badasses!", 'The don has granted his approval!', 'The odds are overwhelmingly stacked against them!', "The second match of the Corneo Cup's semifinals... begins now!", 'Un-freaking-believable! What the hell did I just see!?', 'Ladies and gentlemen, our time together is almost over!', "We know—we're just as disappointed as you are! But ladies and gentlemen, all good things must come to an end! So let's celebrate by getting so damn loud—they'll hear us up on the plaaate!", 'Yeah! Come on, now! Come on, you can do better than that! And now—five-time winners of the Corneo Cup! Murder machines with countless kills to their names!', 'The deadly duo that takes out the trash—with a vengeance!', 'Come on out!', 'The final match of the Corneo Cup... begins now!', "This has never—! I can't believe it! And the winners of the Corneo Cup—the deadly and dynamic duo, Cloud and Aerith!", 'But nobody felt it more keenly than one Don Corneo... who has decided that a bonus match is in order!', 'Their opponent! Buried in the bowels of the colosseum... An unspeakable horror, long imprisoned, set free tonight for your entertainment!', 'Enter: the Hell House!', 'The manifestation of pure evil versus the most badass couple this side of Midgar—have you ever seen a fight more incredible, more epic!?', "They'll be singing songs about tonight for generations to come!", "The Cup's final, final battle... ", 'Begins... now!', 'The battle is joined, and already I can tell you this bonus match will not disappoint!', "Who will come out on top!? Strap yourselves in, folks, 'cause this show is only getting started!", "That had to hurt! Has our dynamic duo already found this house's major design flaw!?", 'A heroic move by Aerith as she provides support for her partner! Savor that healing wind!', "We have a special guest that wants to kick things up a notch! But don't get too close—you can't handle his heat!", 'Tearing through the colosseum like a tornado, a moogle and chocobo!', "Grab your coats, folks! You're gonna wanna bundle up for this! We've got the queen of ice herself coming in for a meet and greet. What a beauty!", 'A fat chocobo from the heavyweight division joins the combatants in the arena! I think the feathers are about to fly!', "The spiteful dragon of the sea is here in the arena! I'm warning you folks: you *will* get wet!", 'What? Do my eyes deceive me? The king of dragons has graced us with his royal presence!', "Cloud is shaken—and stirred! I bet he's not gonna be standing for much longer!", 'Can you hear that, Midgar? Aerith fans are not happy!', 'Aerith is down for the count!', 'This housewarming party is putting their love to the test! Are they strong enough to pull through?', 'The babe and beautiful Cloud and Aerith would be champions reduced to food for the beast. We will never forget your sacrifice!', "The Hell House is d-d-d-down! Cloud is taking control of the fight and is really showing this building who's boss!", 'Whoa! And in a stunning turn of events, the Hell House has come to a complete stop!', 'And the Hell House is down! Will this be the end for our quaint living space of evil?', 'Just try and call this house warm and inviting now! We dare ya! We double-dog dare ya!', "Who has been caught in the Hell House's sights!?", "The Hell House has welcomed its first guest! What kind of party is it!? I don't know, but I'm glad I wasn't invited!", 'And with that, the gateway to hell slams shut!', "This house is hungry, and it's about to chow down on the competition!", 'A miraculous escape from our courageous contender! But from the looks of it, they had a pretty wild time in there!', 'And Cloud is back with us once again... or is he!? The masticating mansion did a real number on the man!', 'The Hell House is ready to shove its message of hate down their throats!', 'Oh, man! Did anyone get the number of that house!?', "What a brutal hit by the Hell House! There's no way that didn't hurt!", 'Talk about making an impact! The Hell House is absolutely tearing it up tonight!', 'Cloud and Aerith with a stunning reversal! The Hell House is dead in the water!', "The lovebirds are going hard at the house, but they'll have to do better than that if they wanna raze *this* roof!", "Well, that sure ain't workin'!", 'Nope! Not gonna cut it!', 'Not even so much as a flinch!', "The barrier's still holding! Does our dynamic duo have what it takes to defeat the security of this high-tech home!?", 'Our favorite couple is about to get a face full of flame! Is there any way to escape the heat!?', 'Here comes the windup, folks! Brace for impact!', "Looks like our couple's in for another round of musical chairs!", 'Stuffed animals are available at the colosseum gift shop. The perfect present for friends and family! Available only while supplies last so act fast!', "Liftoff! We have liftoff! Ladies and gentlemen, are you seeing this!? The world's first flying house!", 'This house has had enough of the neighborhood riffraff!', 'Our tremendous twosome has put on their hard hats! They know exactly what they need to do to make this house come crashing down!', 'Well, wouldja look at this! A gift from the selfless and generous Don Corneo himself!', 'The crowd is going wild, but no amount of applause is gonna bring this house down!', 'Are we witnessing the final moments of the wicked Hell House!?', 'Cloud and Aerith!', 'Okay, my beautiful ladies! Time to line up for the don!', "Wait. You look kinda familiar. We haven't met before, have we?", "Eh, whatever. Alright! Y'all good to go? Then let's do this thing! Introducing Wall Market's most elegible bachelor... The one and only Don Corneo!", "And tomorrow's or the day after's—if the don takes a shine to you.", "Hell yeah! Okay ladies, y'all coming with me.", 'Ayo, fellas, we\'ve got guests! And y\'all got first crack at "entertaining" them! Courtesy of the ever-generous Don Corneo himself! Never forget—the don provides!', 'Help, somebody! Hey!', "You mother— Uh, I mean... Hey, there. Would you mind helping me out? I'm kind of in a bind, as you can see... ", 'Thanks, you guys! Man, these jerks from Shinra showed up outta nowhere! Accused me of leaking information and called me "useless." And, well, the rest is history. Well, anyway, thanks for helping me out. Peace out!']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["My fellow grounders, listen up, because boy, do I have some news for you! And it's assured to knock your socks all the way into next week! Gather round, 'cause this is the good stuff!", "So, after bombing Reactors 1 and 5, what do the eco-terrorists do? They go for the trifecta and take out Mako Reactor 7! Another attack by amateurs who don't care about collateral damage. The sky is falling and Avalanche is to blame! But wait! Did you know Wutai is the one funding their activities!? For all their claims about fighting for the slums... they're nothing more than pawns of Wutai—puppets dancing to the tune of their foreign masters! And that's the truth! Topside news delivered straight to your ears! That'll be five gil. Five gil—come on!", "Five gil apiece—cough it up! The truth ain't free, you know!", "What? It wasn't me. You've got the wrong girl! Never committed a crime in my life!", "Kyrie? Who's that? Can't say I know her, but cool name.", "Oh, that? I thought I was in actual trouble. Don't scare me like that!", 'Oh yeah, I did do that. Good times, good times.', "Hold on. I know you, blondie! You're that merc everyone's talking about! Maybe my luck's not so bad. Shinra's after me. You've gotta help me.", "No! Well, yes, sorta—it's complicated. How was I supposed to know they were Shinra? And now those jerks won't leave me alone! Even though all I took was some ugly key. I mean, what's the big deal anyway?", "... Oh greqt. So, everyone's talking about it? Is this the end? Am I a dead woman? Do I have to go on the run? Leave Midgar forever and never look back?", "It's a deal! Right about now, those Shinra creeps should be hanging out at the colosseum. They're waiting for a special match to start, starring yours truly. It's the talk of the town.", "Oh, I won't be there. I'm not stupid.", "I'll take that as a compliment. Now run along and clean up my mess.", "You'll get your key... once I know I'm safe.", "Man, if I'd known he was Shinra... Well, lesson learned.", "So, how'd it go?", 'Really!? (sighs) That is so good to hear!', 'Totally! From now on, I only steal from the right people.', " Talk about a weight off my shoulders. Oh, I completely lost track of time! I'd better get going.", "Grandma!? Why're you here?", "Yeah, yeah... What's it for, anyway? Why do you guys want it?", "Ugh, Grandma! Cut it out. You're embarrassing me... ", 'Attention! For three gil, you can play Fort Condor against the lovely Kyrie!', "You know the drill. You wanna play, you gotta fork over—Hm? What's your deal? And why're you dressed like a five-year-old? That's just weird.", 'Huh?', "Sure, I'll put you through your paces... but you do know it's gonna cost ya, right? One match, three gil. Play up.", 'Um, excuse me? I cheated and I *still* lost?', "Whatever. You still owe me for my time. It's gotta be worth... seven gil at least!", "I don't wanna think about it. Maybe I should just go home and pass out."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Not so fast, buddy. Back it up. Got no need for pretty boys here.', 'Lemme guess. First time in Wall Market.', "So people can't just walk through the don's front door. Especially men.", "Maybe, but you're gonna wish you didn't.", '"Kinda cute" is not gonna cut it.', "Do you have any idea what you're getting yourself into?", "If you're really sure you wanna join an audition, then you're gonna need to get official approval.", "The Trio—the only ones in town who're considered authorities on Corneo's particular tastes. First, there's Chocobo Sam. And then there's Madam M, over at the massage parlor. Last but not least, there's the Honeybee Inn's Andrea Rhodea. They're an eccentric bunch, to put it mildly, and you should know they don't recommend just any girl stupid enough to come knocking.", "If you're hell-bent on getting in, then go bother the Trio.", "Sorry—the madam will have to wait. The don's demanding that we tack on one more match, it seems.", 'If they win out, then you get paid in full.', 'His call, not mine.', 'You again.', "You know that's only good for women, right?", "Who? Oh, that girl you were with. Sorry to hear that. Well, either way, you're stuck out here, pal. I can't let you in.", 'Wouldn\'t try it if I were you. Trust me, you don\'t wanna screw with the don. If you even think about causing trouble, he\'ll make sure someone pays for it. And that "someone" might wind up being the girl you\'re trying so hard to break out. Or it could wind up being someone you\'ve never even met before. Get it? You\'re in the don\'s world now. Anyway, you\'ve got some time. The audition won\'t start for a while. If you\'re sure you wanna go through with this, then bring the girl and the letter. But... if I were you, I wouldn\'t.', 'Go on, get outta here.', 'No way.', 'You serious?', "I hope you know what you're in for.", 'If you say so. Come on.', "Andrea filled me in on the situation. I come bearing gifts—your gear. I'll do what I can to clean this up. Just finish the job.", 'Better hurry.', 'Long time no see. What brings you back here?', 'Is that so... In that case, I can help.', 'Follow me.', "Unfinished business. If you three give me a hand with it, I'll give you what you need to get topside.", "Corneo's hidey-hole. That's where I'm headed.", "If that's what you think, walk away. I'll find somebody else to work with. And you'll have to find another way to get topside.", 'Fine by me.', "I'll tell you more after we've climbed down. When you're good to go, let me know.", 'You guys ready?', 'Okay. Follow me.', "No one's ever gotten out alive. Well. Until recently that is.", 'Long as you hold up yours—yeah.', "I'd save your bullets for the monsters if I were you. Some are a lot tougher than you'd think. Hate to say it, but I can barely take 'em on my own. You, on the other, shouldn't have any trouble, am I right?", "Head for the trunk line—it marks the border with Sector 7. You three lead the way. I'll follow a short distance behind.", "Hate to interrupt, but the trunk line's just through that door. The one over there.", "This way. There should be a door with Corneo's mark on it around here somewhere.", 'Your time to shine. Clear the path ahead, would you?', 'Andrea. He told me to.', "And I couldn't bring myself to let it happen again... ", "It doesn't matter. Let's go.", "Wait. We're getting close to Corneo's hideout. From here on, I'll take the lead.", 'Yeah.', 'Through here.', 'No... Wait! We gotta catch him!', "He took the key to the door! Without it, we're screwed!", "Shit! Don't lose him!", "Deal with 'em!", "Up. As if this wasn't enough fun already.", "The area up ahead—it's that thing's den. Keep your eyes peeled. You never know when its friends're gonna pop up, or where.", 'Give it back!', 'Give it back.', 'Give it back.', 'Sorry.', 'No... ', 'Six months ago... On that day Corneo picked her as a bride. And on the next she vanished without a trace. But before she did, she gave it back. Salt on the wound. Thing cost me a small fortune.', "Revenge. I know I need to let go, but I can't. I need closure, 'cause without it... I'll never be able to move on.", "Thanks. And don't worry, I got you.", 'I know a shortcut. Follow me.', "Corneo's mine, and mine alone.", 'Please.', 'Wait outside.', "It's Leslie! Got some urgent info for hte don!", "'Course.", "Actuallly... it's them I came to talk about.", "When you think... you've already won.", "Where's Corneo?", "It's fine. I'll track him down eventually. Not like I have anything better to do.", 'Was it a message? What was she trying to tell me?', 'Huh?', "Then I guess I've got no choice but to find her first. Thanks.", "I haven't. Found it. Let's get outta here. And then I'll give you what you need.", 'This way.', "Grappling guns. You can practically fly with the souped-up motors on these babies. Sector 7 is on the other side of that wall. The guns will get you over and past it, along with any number of other obstacles. But—they're one-way tickets. So once you start up, there's no coming back. You should probably get your affairs in order. Just in case.", "That right? Hope you find 'em."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Well this ain't a charity—so if you don't have the gil to pay, then get the hell out!", 'Welcome, welcome. Just the two of you? Step right up. Now then, what manner of massage do you desire?', 'This your first time in our establishment? We are a hand-massage parlor. An excess of fatigue and tension can make even the simplest task a terrible strain. It is our pleasure to relieve our patrons of that tension. (chuckles) And what better way to seek relief than through the skilled ministrations of a professional? So now that we understand each other, what manner of massage do you desire?', 'Then you are... ?', "Oh for the love of— Say another word and I'll shove this fan right down your throat!", "This is the last thing I need. You're young and stupid, and I suppose that means you think I'll let you off easy. So you want what? A favor? Well, here's the thing... This is a massage parlor—a respectable establishment. But if you don't require our services... Then tell me! Is there any reason I shouldn't have you dragged outside and shot for wasting my valuable time!? Well!?", 'Hm. Name?', 'Hand.', 'Give it to me!', "The strong, firm hands of a fighter... yet they possess a certain elegance and grace. Okay, Cloud. Let's see what you're made of. After that... we'll talk.", 'So. Which course will it be?', "Hmph! If you're not a customer, then get out.", 'Ready to take the plunge, are we.', 'Keep your filthy hands to yourself.', 'Do you even know how much that costs?', "If you break it, you're paying for it.", "Hey! You don't have enough for that. Why don't you choose a course you can actually afford?", ' Then make your way to the room in the back... and wait.', 'This exclusive treatment is reserved for our most well-to-do patrons... First... the hand cream... A generous coating for each and every one of your richly deserving fingers... ', "Let's start... with the tips... That's it. Relax. I'm only here to help.", 'Oh? Did that hurt?', "Then I'll move on... to the base of the fingers... Let's see if we can't improve your circulation. Get that blood flowing.", "No, don't fight it. Stress is poison to the body. And finally... some gentle simulation for the palm. No more than a touch. Just like this.", 'Oh? What was that? A cry of pleasure? Is this how you like it? How about this? Or maybe this?', 'If that was to your liking, do come again.', 'Well then. It should go without saying that you get what you pay for. All four fingers at once. Quick and to the point.', "Hm? I can stop at any time if it's too much to handle.", "Try flexing the muscles. You'll feel the difference.", 'Loose and limber. Am I right?', "I should warn you. This technique has certain risks. It's somewhat... experimental. You may find it extremely pleasurable and rewarding. Or the opposite.", 'Absolutely not. You asked for this, now take it like a man!', "Think you'll make a habit of it?", "All right then. I think I've seen everything I need to see.", "Tell me what you want and we'll take it from there.", 'And why in the world would you want to do that? Hmmm... Okay.', 'But. You cannot go dressed like that.', 'I could never send Corneo a candidate wearing such a plain-looking getup. Doing so would call my position as one of the Trio into question.', 'Look, just... take it outside the parlor, would you?', "You just leave that to me. I'll put you in a dress so fabulous, you'll look like a million gil. So long as you can afford it.", "What I said. But don't worry. It's obvious you can't afford a dress with that kind of price tag. So listen. I have an idea. There's an underground colosseum in this town. Up for a fight, Cloud? Good, because I'm getting you into that arena. If you win the tournament, I'll transform Aerith into a drop-dead gorgeous beauty.", 'Yes—for the person who got you in. So? What do you say?', "That's what I like to hear. You'll need this. They're already letting fighters inside. You should hurry, run along.", 'Remember: you are going to win me that money.', "Well, of course he is. I did give him a massage you know. His palm told quite the tale. He's cheated death more than a few times... ", 'There you go again. One of these days your "luck" is going to run out.', 'That is one mistake I will *never* repeat.', 'My condolences.', "Oh! You're taking this rather well. I was looking forward to a little temper tantrum.", "You're right of course—even if they are both the same.", 'And now, I believe I have a prize to collect.', 'What?', 'Now hold on just a goddamn minute!', 'Sorry to be the bearer of bad news. But... you still have one fight left.', "The crowd loved your show a little too much. People were placing hefty bets, much heftier than you can possibly imagine. Corneo's going to milk this for as much as he can.", "You face and defeat Corneo's fighter of choice, and only then will you be declared winners of the tournament.", "Don't you think I know that!?
