(groans) You greedy bastard! Scum-sucking piece of shit festering asshole!", " But that's the way it is. Corneo's the one who makes the rules around here. But if you win this match, Corneo will have to accept your victory. And the crowd will make sure he does.", 'I sure hope so.', 'Go on, now. That prize money is going to pay for your dress.', "It's almost disappointing.", 'Yay! Yes!', 'Awfully rare, you showing an interest in someone. What will you do?', "You're here. Good. I have everything I need to get started. Just one thing before we do. You're *the* Cloud, right? Cloud the merc?", "Hah! Well that's what you call yourself I'm told, but what've you actually done for the people of Sector 5, hmm? There's this little thing called karma. How a person treats others dictates how they themselves should be treated. And believe me—I'll get you the dress that you earned.", "I've heard a few stories about you helping out the people of Sector 5. If you don't mind me saying so, though, you could be doing a little bit more. The rule of karma is highly respected in the slums. A somewhat decent person deserves a somewhat decent dress. But really, let's not kid ourselves. Corneo's not even gonna look at what she's wearing.", 'I\'m told you did a wonderful job helping the people of Sector 5. You have a very impressive work ethic. It\'s like they say, "Good things come to those who work." What goes around, comes around—and in ways that might surprise you. I\'m gonna put Aerith in the most gorgeous dress you\'ve ever seen. It\'ll be a real jaw-dropper.', "All right. Now that that's out of the way... Once you change, you won't be able to leave town. Are you sure you're ready?", "All right, then. Let's get started. Beauty takes a lot of work and preparation, far more than you'd know. In the meantime, let me see, let me think... ", "Huh!? Don't waste my time! If you have things to do, then get out there and do them!", "Like I said, once you change, you won't be able to leave town. Are you sure you're ready now?", 'Hurry. It. Up!', "There oughta be things you can only do without your friend. Now's your chance to get out and have some fun. I can tell you're already beginning to feel at home here. Though being so new to it I assumed you still wouldn't know how to enjoy yourself properly. So I went and had a chat with Sam. He said he'd be happy to help you out.", "But there's so much you don't know! This is the perfect opportunity for you to learn the ways of the world and man the hell up!", "You look like you haven't experienced the best of what this town has to offer. That really won't do.", "Then maybe you can show the town what you have to offer instead. Which is to say, why don't you try putting those finely honed mercenary skills of yours to good use here in Wall Market? I have a few little requests that you might be able to help out with. I gave that hand extra-special treatment. Now get out there and show me what you can do with it.", "And that's enough of that. Aerith, come with me.", "The dress is part of it, sure... but we'll also need to do something about that plain-Jane makeup and hairdo. This is gonna take some work.", "Peek and I'll poke out your eyes.", 'I thought I told you. No peeking!', 'You have a lot of nerve.', 'How old are you?', "Very nicely done! (chuckles) Here's your cut—you earned it.", "My people are working on her hair right now. I thought I'd take the opportunity to drop by and watch your match. (laughs) I have to admit, I never get tired of seeing Sam's precious toys take a beating.", "I can tell by your hands you've come a long way. They're the hands of a fighter... who has found new purpose. A woman... or two? I wonder... ", " Anyway, Aerith should be finishing up soon. I'll go on ahead to check on her. Whenever you're ready, come back to the parlor.", 'My, my! Is that Cloud? Darling! I had no idea.', "Don't we look absolutely stunning in our dress? Not that I ever had any doubt you would, darling. I was a little pressed for time since Andrea didn't give me much notice, but I did my humble best. How could I not go the extra mile for the merc who's done so very much for me and mine. What's one more dress between friends?", 'No, you certainly do not, and I doubt that you ever will.', 'I have to admit, that was quite the show.', 'Off you trot. And remember: Corneo plays for keeps.', 'Well, this is a fine mess... ', "Compared to Sector 7, we're doing fine. But that's hardly an accomplishment.", 'How ever did it come to this... ?', "I don't like not knowing what's going on... ", "If it isn't Cloud.", "Good luck with that. Security's so tight these days that not even a gnat could slip through. Wall Market's in a sorry state, too. Corneo's men are turning it upside down looking for Avalanche.", 'Hmm? The man with a gun for an arm... ', "No, but you might. Corneo's men are searching high and low for an Avalanche member who fits your description. Shinra has placed a very impressive bounty on you and your friends' heads. And a lot of people are looking to get rich.", 'You should also know that you and that arm of yours were spotted in the Sector 5 slums. Apparently, you were loitering in a rather lovely flower garden?', 'Do be careful on your way back to the slums.', "Been saying a lot less of Corneo's men lately. Your doing?", "I know that look. You're up to no good, aren't you? (chuckles) Good luck.", 'Do stop by again if you desire additional treatment.']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Reunion... Reunion... ']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Well, now. You must be Cloud. I'm Marle, your landlady. So how'd you like the place? You from up on high?", "I'll bet. No matter. All kinds come through with all kinds of reasons. If you ever need an ear to bend, I'll lend you mine. Can be about anything—even Tifa.", "The granddaughter I never had. And if you hurt her, I'll take it out of your hide. You hear me?", "Good! Now you'd best get a move on to Seventh Heaven! She's got a head start on you and then some.", "You know Tifa's probably wondering why you haven't joined her yet.", 'Come on, quit lollygagging and go to Seventh Heaven already!', "Is your face always that pale? You're not getting enough sleep!", "Tifa! My dear, dear girl! ... Oh. What's he doing here?", "You'd better take care of her!", 'That I do. Still, better him than you. No charm, no wit. Big sword... but no skills.', "You're looking awfully glum. Are you getting enough sleep? A good long rest'll cure anything, I tell you.", 'That you are. Now—your money.', "Don't do anything I wouldn't do!", "You'd better not cause Tifa any heartache!", "You'd have more color in your cheeks if you went to bed earlier!", "Don't you still have work to do? Well, go on, then—get back to it!", "Huh? Someone's back awful early. Not that I mind! Would you two be dears and swap your filters out for me? I left them in your rooms.", 'Not so fast, you. Do me a favor. She needs a friend—a real friend.', 'So when she talks, are you really listening? Thinking about her and her feelings? Or are you just going through the motions? Go on.', "Take care you two! ... Oh? You're looking pretty chipper!", 'Must be my imagination then. (chuckles) Anyway! Keep your wits about you, merc! A token of my appreciation. Be good to her.', "You'll get no second chances from me.", 'Swing by anytime if you want advice. Or just to talk, even.', "People need more than empty words. They need to know you're there for them, and you'll *still* be there for them when things get tough. That knowledge alone can give a woman wings.", "Slow down! Do you know what's going on? What do they want with the pillar?", "They're going to drop the plate on us?", 'Feel free to cry about it later! Right now, we need to get everyone to safety.', 'Ah, good thinking! Hop to it!', 'Avalanche, I take it?', "Tell Tifa to lay low. We'll take care of things here.", "C'mon, keep moving! This way! Hey! Hey! Over here! C'mon!", 'This way, people! Quickly now! Keep moving!', 'Of course.', "Just a little more! Come on! C'mon!", "You're alive!", "I can't tell you how relieved I am to see you. So. What now?", 'Been back to the bar yet?', 'Maybe you should go take a look.', "Careful. The roads are a mess. Watch your step or you'll wind up in a hole!", "I take it that little Marlene's safe and sound?", "That little girl's a hell of a lot stronger than you might think.", 'Oh, what brings you here?', "The Angel of the Slums? You didn't meet her, did you? Tell me, what was she like?", "A shame. Bless her sweet soul... I don't know what to say... I'll make sure the funds are put to good use. Here, why don't you take this? Something tells me you can use it more than me.", "Got the place a guard dog. Figured it'd spare my tenants the troubles of chasin' off nosy men.", "Ah, have business with the merc, do ya? If it's a job you want done, he's your man, but otherwise don't bother.", "Just what do you think you're doing, young lady?", "And whaddya want with *that*, exactly? Better yet, who are you? Heard some punks've been hasslin' the nice people at the Happy Turtle, rippin' down their flyers. Are you one of 'em?", "So you're trying to sneak a peek at the merc? Not that I blame ya. Boy's easy on the eyes, I'll give him that much.", "But cut your losses, honey. Unless you like your men silent and emotionally unavailable. Merc's built a wall around himself so damn high, even he can't see over it. He'll never tell you what he's thinking. And that attitude of his... ! I tried to get through to him—but would he listen? Would he?", 'Then what *are* you here for?', "Sorry, merc's not here.", 'Here for advice? Gonna have to wait your turn.', 'Something about today. Not sure what... ']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Daddy! You're home!", "Yeah, I've been helping Tifa.", "Daddy, the mako place blew up. Everyone on TV's talking about it.", 'Daddy says never talk to strangers.', "But I'm not tired! I wanna talk some more, Daddy... ", 'Um, Daddy... did the people who died all return to the planet?', 'Did you... have fun?', 'Okay!', '... And... the kids that the black wind carries away have to live in the train graveyard forever and ever! So you have to stay far, far away from there!', 'Oh, you know Betty? Yesterday she went with her daddy to... to... ', 'When is... Daddy coming back?', 'The kids that the black wind carries away have to live in the train graveyard forever and ever!', 'Who... who are you?', 'Um... Where is she?', 'Daddy too?', "Wait... Daddy's not coming home?", 'Are they gonna destroy the bar? Are they gonna destroy our house?', 'You smell nice.', 'Like... like our flower.', 'Do you think that I could help too?', ' Ummm... ', 'Daddy!', 'Are you going?', 'Hm?', "'Kay! That girl... She was kinda... ", 'Nothing. You should help her.', "You'll come back... right?", 'Okay. You can go!', 'Wow!', 'Coming!', 'Daddy... ?']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Good to see you too, Aerith. I'd heard you found yourself a funny new friend.", 'He looks useful enough. The kids have been talking about you. The defender of the secret hideout. And now the Hero of the Leaf House is helping the Daily Buzz look for the Angel of the Slums.', " I'm a lover of the whispered word. Not that it's any real secret, considering how chatty that Shinra mutt's been.", "Or could it be you've fallen under the Angel's spell like so many others? Anyway—it so happens that I have some information for you. But I'll need a moment before I can give it to you. Why don't you wait with that reporter of yours?", "Just wait outside with the reporter. I'll be along soon.", "This old bird had a change of heart, that's all.", "I don't know anything about that. But I do know where her hideout is.", "Deep in the scrap—at Lookout Point. Hardly anyone goes out there these days. It's the perfect place for a criminal to hole up.", "But before you go, I should warn you about this rumor I heard—about a terrible fiend that's claimed the Angel's hideout as its lair. Quite large, lots of teeth, always hungry. I don't know about you, but I'd not go anywhere near that thing.", 'If it\'s a "plan" you\'re looking for, I\'d say you have one right here. Wouldn\'t you?', "Heard the monster up at Lookout Point ain't your average beastie. You be careful now.", "Don't let that thing lay a claw on Aerith, you hear me?", 'Hm. This oughta be good. Best be on your way, merc.', 'Hmm... So this is one of her famous warnings.', "If the merc here hadn't bailed you out, that fiend in the scrap would've ripped you to shreds. Sorry about that, friend. Here I was just trying to help you out, but instead my kindness almost got you violently killed.", "Here. Why don't you take this? Oh, and no need to thank me. Let's just say it slipped out of that reporter's pocket. (laughs) Can't call it theft if you're just claiming what you're owed—am I right? Well done, mister merc. You certainly lived up to your reputation.", "You know, there's a rumor that the Angel of the Slums is as radiant and beautiful as she is daring. Personally, I think that one's true.", 'Now what could our Angel want from a man like Don Corneo? Of all his many goodies—or maybe she wants his whole fortune!', "Oh, don't be an idiot! The Angel would never stoop so low as to steal from children! I'm telling you, I saw the real culprits.", "What? No there's not!", 'Hell no!', 'How can you!?', 'Madam M told me about a merc. That you? Maybe you can help us sort this out. Some criminals have stolen a shipment of donations bound for the Leaf House. The fiends!', 'Oh, come on! "Garden angle"!? Listen to me. I guarantee this is not the work of the Angel. I saw it with my own eyes. Three shady-looking types wandering around, scouting their mark I bet.', "You heard the man, merc. I've got to find those thieves to clear the Angel's name—and I need your help to do it. She would never, ever, do anything to harm the less fortunate. Find the three I saw and bring them here to me. They ran off toward the old expressway on the other side of Evergreen Park.", "The expressway's just past Evergreen Park. Hurry—those thieves've got a head start. They won't catch themselves!", "Hmph, you don't honestly thing that the beloved Angel of the Slums could be any of these three idiots, do you?", "Well, you should be sorry. I'll consider us square once you've taught these boys a lesson.", 'Kind of you to offer, but I can manage on my own. I know these streets like the back of my hand. Better, even.', "Well, I'll be seeing ya. Thanks to you, we can put this mess behind us. I'm grateful.", "I owe you for your help. Here. I'm no fashionista, but I'm sure this'll go great with that dress of yours.", "Oh, too good for my gifts, huh? Come on, just take it already, would you? Got these things comin' out of my ears as it is. Now get goin'. Teach that greasy slime ball a lesson he won't soon forget.", 'Hold it!', 'You, young lady, are gonna hear about this later. Thank you for keeping her out of trouble.', "What? Did I forget to mention it to you? Kyrie's my granddaughter—my flesh and blood. See? We even have the same eyes.", "Kyrie, the key. You've kept them waiting long enough.", "And how's that any of your business, young lady? Learn to wipe your own ass before you start rooting around in other people's shit.", 'Me embarrass you? Says the girl who steals from anyone. Even a thief needs principles, not to mention the courage of convictions to follow their conscience. Take it from me—the Guardian Angel of the Slums.', "And you three are Avalanche. There's a fire in you. I can see it flickering in your eyes. That same fire's in me, too. The Guardian Angel of the Slums, Avalanche—they're just names. We are who we choose to be. But you have to decide who that is, and commit. Make the most of your time while you still have it. Right?", "I hear Corneo's got secret rooms hidden in the sewers. More than even he knows, if the rumors are true.", 'That reminds me—someone spotted a tacky-looking door over by the collapsed expressway.', "If you're curious, there's another door that's got Corneo's emblem and everything on it, right by the Angel's hideout."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["You can see me, kupo? Then you two must be very, very special people. In that case... Welcome to the Moogle Emporium! I'm the owner—Moggie!", "That's right, kupo! I opened a store to bring happiness to the slums—like Mog! And you know, only people with the purest of hearts can even see moogles!", "Well... moogle magic isn't perfect, kupo. Anyway, we've collected all kinds of rare and wonderous goods! They can be yours if you've got enough moogle medals. But you'll need to buy a membership first!", 'If you find any moogle medals, you can spend them here, kupo!', "Oh, you know what! I use them to make everyone happy! That's the duty of every moogle!", 'Good to see you, kupo!', 'Welcome, kupo.', "You guys are great! Thanks to you, I've got a ton of medals, kupo! Which means I can bring happiness to a ton of people!", "I'll need a lot more medals, kupo!", 'Good luck, guys!', 'A pleasure as always, kupo.']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Oh... You're that former SOLDIER, aren't you? Cloud, was it?", "Yeah! I am pretty upset. The kids are still off doing patrols, even though it's now time for their lessons. Not a single one of them has come back yet!", "That's right. In return for the donations we receive, the kids go around town picking up litter, running errands—that kind of thing. I don't suppose you've seen any of them, have you? You see, I have some important plans this evening, and I really need to go and get ready.", 'That would be wonderful! There are five of them out on patrol right now. They all wear homemade swords on their back, so they should be easy to spot.', "The children finally came back—thanks to you two. You've been a great help. Okay, everyone! Come inside—it's time to hit the books!", "Okay, kids, playtime's over for now! I've prepared a special assignment for everyone. One that I expect you to finish today. Understood?", 'I appreciate you getting rid of the toad king, by the way.', "Oh, if only. Easier said than done. They're always on the move, looking for new adventures, chasing new dreams, all while trying to make the lives of everyone around them just a little better. I try to make sure they don't stumble and fall, and when they finally do, I help them back up.", "Sometimes it is. But I want the children to know that until they can stand on their own two feet that I'm here to support them, care for them, love them—that even if we're not actually related, we're still a family—a real family, in all the ways that matter. If I can do that for them, then well... then maybe I'm making this world a better place.", "My predecessor taught me everything I know. I just took up his torch and ran with it, I guess. Not that I'm anything close to what he was. Biggs is one of a kind.", "Oh no! I've completely lost track of time!", 'More like a dream I need to fulfill! Thank you again for your help!', '... What?', "Hey! What the hell, merc!? Digging into people's personal affairs in this town is a huge no-no!", "Well, if you must know... I've wanted to be a dancer ever since I was a little girl. I come here at night to live the dream. I'd appreciate it if you didn't tell the children, okay?", "I practice every second I can. It's the only way I'll become the best!", "I've always wanted to dance for a living.", 'How far could they have gone?', 'Yes, of course. Thank you so very much.', 'Thank you, I appreciate the help.', "Plates aren't supposed to ust fall. I mean, what's going on up there?", 'Please come back safe and sound. Please.']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Step back.', "Factory's off-limits. Drakes have been spotted inside.", "Huh? Wait a minute. Tifa? Don't tell me you're here to take care of those things. Are you? In that case, be my guest! We believe there's at least two groups lurking somewhere inside the factory. Find and cull 'em all.", "Reports said the drakes looked like they were nesting. Need you to clear 'em out before they breed.", "If it ain't the merc himself."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["He's out on the town as we speak. Really seems to be enjoying it here.", 'Sheesh. You ninjas are insane.', "You must be tired from your trip. Why don't you get some rest?", "Actually... I kind of don't. At least, not an exact location. All I know is that Shinra—for most purposes—treats materia as a weapon. Which means the Advanced Weaponry Division probably deals with it. And since that's in the basement... ", 'Just be careful, will you? Please?', 'Oh yeah, you should introduce yourself to Billy Bob. He knows a thing or two about the Shinra Building.', "Sonon's still not back? Must be in Wall Market, then.", "There's lots of different establishments. It's... kinda hard to explain.", 'Uh... ', "Interesting. There's a Happy Turtle in Midgar as well.", "I don't know where exactly, because I've never actually been, but I do see their flyers from time to time.", 'Come to think of it... There\'s a man who goes around putting up flyers for the bar. People call him "Old Snapper." And he doesn\'t dress like your average Midgar male. Might be from Wutai.', "I won't stop you. Just don't go too far, okay?", "Ah, there you are. Someone's been expecting you.", 'Okay. Yuffie, Sonon. You mind coming along?', "We'll be passing through a rough part of town, so you'll wanna go prepared. I'll leave you to get ready. Hit met up outside when you're done, okay?", 'You guys all set?', 'Okay. Streets are kind of a maze, so stay close.', 'Take all the time you need.', 'Yuffie? Where are you going?', "To pick up your IDs. There's no way to get topside without 'em.", "He is, but those are different. It takes more than one ID—or even two—to survive in this town. Don't forget, Midgar was built by Shinra, for Shinra.", 'So, Yuffie, what do you think of the undercity?', 'And the crowds stop bothering you eventually. The place can grow on you if you give it a chance.', "Midgar isn't the enemy—Shinra is. I know Ws don't really see the distinction, but... we do.", 'Shh!', 'Those guys there are from the splinter cell.', "They're the ones who blew up the reactors.", 'Yeah. My thoughts exactly.', "The people in the splinter cell, they couldn't care less about collateral damage... long as Shinra goes down.", "We're not out to blow Midgar up or tear it down—we want to save it from Shinra. Look around. Nine outta ten of the people living here are innocent bystanders. We can't level their home to take down one company.", 'Yeah, I get that.', "We're just doing what we think is necessary... to build a brighter future. That's all there is to it.", "Uh, can we table this for later, maybe? Not sure now's the best time for heavy topics.", 'So... what exactly does this "ultimate materia" do? I\'m guessing you have big plans for it?', 'I guess you will... ', 'You want me to be one of Corneo\'s brides, is that it? Which makes you a "person of influence," right?', "What're you doing!? Get your hands off me? Ugh!", 'Don Corneo\'s "talent scouts." They\'ll say and do just about anything to get unsuspecting girls back to the don\'s mansion.', "Well, we're here. Now we just have to wait.", "Not sure. We used to have someone who could make fake IDs in-house, but... they went off with the splinter cell. We've never dealt with this particular vendor before.", "Mako poisoning. That's what happens if you don't make the grade as a SOLDIER... or when the military's done using you.", 'Thank you.', 'We should probably head back and wait for Zhijie.', "Huh. What's this about?", 'Otherwise known as "the roof of the slums." Follow me, guys.', 'You like living in the fast lane, huh.', 'Almost there.', "You two go after Zhijie. I'll head back and tell the others what happened.", 'Shh!', "Sorry we couldn't give you a proper send-off. Just know that we're rooting for you, okay?"]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Weiss? This is a surprise. To what do I owe the pleasure?', ' When will Shinra learn? There is no replicating *you*. They ought to know better.', 'I am. It has been too long since my last hunt.', '"Team"? Fool. There are no "teams" in Deepground.', 'The place where my brother and I like to play.', 'Now... let the games begin.', 'Do I frighten you?', 'You cannot run from me.', 'I have you now.', 'How dare you? How *dare* you stand in my way?', 'Now then... where were we?', 'Surrender to the darkness. Embrace it.', 'All your suffering will soon be at an end.', 'All your suffering will soon be at an end.', 'Oh, Weiss. This is it. This is it!', 'This is where you die.', "It's time I brought this to a close.", 'Behold the true beauty of darkness!', ' Yes, savor this pain.', 'Come closer. Allow me to hasten the inevitable.', 'Yes, yes! I must know more of this feeling! Of pain! Of death!']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Aerith!', "Was trying to get a look at the reactor. Who's this guy?", 'See you.', 'Ah!', "Where's Aerith?", "Yeah, two of 'em disappeared. They ran away after this creepy guy wearing black clothes showed up.", "It's this guy who's always stumbling around town in a dirty robe full of holes. They say he's sick or something. Oh, and he had some kind of number tattooed on his arm.", "C'mon.", "C'mon.", "Aerith's come to help.", "I dunno. He disappeared and we can't find him.", "C'mon.", 'They ran off this way. Be careful.', 'Thank you.', "Okay, I will. And here. Since you're so cool. You guys are both grown-ups, but you're also one of us now. You can come and play here whenever you want.", "Hey, Cloud. I know a lot of people around here need help. When I'm out on patrol, a lot of them tell me about their problems. Do you think you might be interested in helping out?", 'I always have the latest information. Come find me if you wanna know.', "The monsters out there are getting stronger and stronger. But that's no problem for you, though, right? ... Be careful anyway.", "Now that things are starting to settle down a bit, we can finally play Whack-a-Box again! It's all thanks to you!", "Oh, yeah, I forgot. There's this tired-looking guy out by the community center... and I heard he was looking for some help.", 'Hey, Cloud.', 'Lost? Who said we were lost? Stupid old man.', 'Well, we saw a bunch of tombstones lying on the ground, so we decided to stand them back up. And then I heard laughing coming from somewhere, and when I turned around, everyone was gone. I was alone.', 'That! I heard that and everyone disappeared.', 'Guys!', "This is where our parents are. They're resting, but we wanted to say hi. Sometimes you just wanna do that, you know?", "Thanks so much for coming to find us! That's another one I owe ya! We're gonna head back to the House now. Ms. Folia's probably pretty worried."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Oh the joy and cheer that await at the Happy Turtle... ', 'Oho! Greetings, softshell. So, how many of those flyers didja find?', 'Ahem! Collect just six flyers for the Happy Turtle, and a one-of-a-kind prize could be yours! Ring any bells?', "Well then! Allow me to explain. The Happy Turtle's running a contest. And the rules are simple. All you have to do is collect six of our fabulous flyers from around Sector 7... and you'll earn yourself a prize sure to delight even the dourest diamondback! Hah hah! Sadly, a handful of locals have taken to acting like stinkpots toward anything Wutaian, 'speciall since the bombings. Some've even gone so far as to tear down my poor posters. Little wonder nobody's won yet.", " Which leaves me in a pretty predicament... But hey, my pain might be your gain. By collecting just a handful of flyers, you could be the first, and—at this rate—the only winner of the most testudinarious contest in Midgar's history! This here's a sample of one of our ads. Breathtaking, isn't it? Now it's up to you to find all six. Leave no shell unturned, no pond unplumbed!", "Ah, since you're here. You wouldn't happen to have any condor coins on you, wouldja? This job may keep a shell over my head, but my real passion's coin collecting. I'd gladly party with some oddities and commodities in exchange for those little beauts.", 'So, what can I do ya for?', "Went to check on one of my flyers, and would't ya know, some rascally youngsters've hidden the darn thing.", "Friend of mine manages some apartments nearby, and she's been kind enough to let me post a flyer.", 'Saw one of my babies floating through the air earlier! Poor thing... ', "The one I put up in Culvert Street's vanished, too. Swiped by one of those pesky cats... ", "Oh, if you overhear any songs, jams, or grooves about the Happy Turtle, be sure and follow 'em.", "Well, well, well... Look what the tide washed in. That's a one, two... three and a four... five and—I can't believe it—six! We have a winner! Three cheers for the Happy Turtle's all-conquering champion! Hip hip, hooray! Hip hip, hooray! Hip hip, hooraaay!", 'Would ya look at that... Da-chao beans! Does this mean what I think it does?', "Well, whaddya know. A real-life ninja, paying Old Snapper a visit. Truth be told, I'd love to have you 'round to the bar, but... you got your hands full. (chuckles) Not to mention the whole underage thing. Still just a young'n, I s'pose, ninja though you are. Well, I don't plan on movin' from Midgar anytime soon, so once your shell's seen a bit more wear and tear, make sure to come on back. Whip you up the finest food and drink this side of Wutai. Only the best for you."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["I'm gonna getcha!", 'What, what? Read this? This paper right here? Give me a moment... "Welcome to the Shinra Building. The Space and Aeronautics Division has taken rocket systems developed for military applications and adapted them to a different purpose: the search for new precious resources in the infinite reaches of space." That being said... since we have plenty of mako at the present, those plans are currently on hold. It\'s a... bit of a shame, really.', 'Oh dear, oh dear... A man of my refined tastes running out of butter! Shorn of its proper accompaniment, this tea... might as well be boiled pond water!', "No, it couldn't possibly have been... ", "I'm telling you, I saw him! With my own eyes! Sauntering down the corridor!", 'He was as close to me as you are now! The shock of it made me spill my tea!']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Yeah, he got in three days ago.', 'You, uh... got any bags?', "Uh, Yuffie? Might wanna wait for Sonon before hittin' the city.", 'You look kinda nervous.', "Huh, well... If you had an ID, you'd normally just take the train up there. But with all the commotion going on, that's not really an option. Security's on high alert. If you ask me, your best bet is to sit tight and wait for things to settle down some.", 'Be my guest, then—go get killed.', 'You look about ready to die of boredom. Wanna play Fort Condor?', " I shoulda known. It hasn't been out long, so there's no way you Ws would've heard of it.", 'For my benefit, then, lemme go over them... ', "Damn, Yuffie! How'd you do that? You totally kicked my ass!", " Well, if you're looking for a challenge, the undercity's got no shortage of serious players.", "Sure 'bout that? Word is if you beat the grandmaster, you can win some serious cash—materia, too.", "That's right. But you should know the hardcore competitors won't give you the time of day till you've proven yourself.", "Says the merchandise is good to go. Handoff's at a depot in municipal storage.", "Splinter cell's done its best to make things hard for ya. Miss this train and there's no telling when the next'll be."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Oho. The eyes of one who has bathed in mako... Which would make you... a SOLDIER?', 'Once a SOLDIER, always a SOLDIER. Though not, alas, for very long. Accelerated cellular degradation being the most common cause of death by far. This is classified, of course, but every SOLDIER knows the truth.', 'Would that I could. You strike me as the type to go on without end.', 'And what a wasteful indulgence it would be even if there were.', 'We do indeed keep on "slurping it up," as you say... But... for whose benefit, I wonder. The true nature of mako is known to one and all, yet the people willfully turn a blind eye to the cost. As you must surely be aware?', "Such methods are beneath me. As are you, my faithful sewer rats. Henceforth allies of wicked Wutai, our sworn enemy. Thank you for stoking our people's patriotic fever.", 'Are we on schedule?', ' Director Tuesti.', 'Reeve. Progress requires sacrifice. Learn to live with it.', 'I trust the narrative is intact?', "Wutai's response?", 'Very well. Then we shall stay the course.', 'Oh?', 'Reeve.', 'Spare us the doom and gloom. Was there anything else?', 'That will not be needed. Not with the Ancient in our custody once more.', 'In their promised land... we will build a new mako-powered metropolis.', 'Professor Hojo.', 'So, she can lead us to the promised land?', 'Proceed as you see fit. However. You will not make the same mistake twice. Is that clear?', 'If there is nothing else.', 'Meeting adjourned.', 'Help! Is anybody there!?', 'Please, help me!', 'Help me! Please!', 'Hey!', 'Is anyone out there!?', 'Heeey!', 'Help me... ', "Pull me up! I'll give you all the money you want! I have gil! Plenty of it!", 'Please!', 'Just let me live. Everything you want can be yours.', "But not all the way. You want something *more*, don't you!?", 'Is that really all you want? For your names to be cleared? Hmph. That is what matters most to you? More than shutting down the reactors? Than the future of the planet itself?', "You're lying to yourself, even now. Truth... justice, honor, freedom! Vain indulgences, every one. Picture it! Picture a world without Shinra. Without mako energy. A stagnant, impotent world. Now picture a natural disaster. Who would help the people? Help the recover and rebuild? You? With their old would ruined, will they thank you for the new? I'm going to give you a chance. One last opportunity to consider what your principles are truly worth. But bear in mind that time is of the essence.", 'What principles!? Did you understand even a single word of what I told you? I know what I want, and I take it. I take advantage of whatever I can, and discard that which I cannot. There is no room for sentiment or guilt.', 'Are we on schedule?', ' Director Tuesti.', 'Reeve. Progress requires sacrifice. Learn to live with it.']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: [" Uh, welcome to Shinra headquarters. My duties as director of Research and Development are, in all likelihood, far beyond your ability to comprehend. So, there will be no presentation, as it would be a waste of my time and yours. But rest assured, we are making great strides. Albeit not at this particular moment, because I'm filming this rubbish instead. I believe I've wasted enough of my precious time as it is. Science waits for no one, after all. So—good day.", 'So. About this precious promised land of yours... Come now, Aerith. You misunderstand my intenions. I wish only to satisfy their material greed so I can be left to pursue my great work. *Our* great work, my dear.', "Hmm. You're the spitting image of her now. I regret it to this day. If she had only trusted me instead of trying to run, it could have played out quite differently. What a terrible tragedy, to lose the last of the pure-blooded Ancients... though not completely. Would like to see your mother? Albeit, through the lens of one of my microscopes. Did you really think we'd leave such a precious specimen to rot in the gutter? We collected and catalogued every last bit of her. Hair, skin, organs, every fragment of every bone... As breathtaking in death as in life! As *you*, my dear! Ifalna was elegance, right down to her cellular structure. (chuckles) And there it is. That same elegance.", "Oh—yes. Time for yet another meeting. Sit tight. I won't be long.", 'The test results were within expectations. The specimen is somewhat lacking compared to her pure-blood mother, but for our purposes she should more than suffice.', 'Well, Mister President, that remains to be seen. I would like your permission to secure her cooperation through more "forceful" means. Forceful yet gentle. She is a precious resource that must be handled with care.', 'I... had something more... psychological in mind. Better to scar the psyche than mar the flesh.', "If I may, Mister President, I have an idea how we might mitigate the risks. Simply put, we could have the Ancient reproduce. In the absence of a second specimen, we would need to identify an alternative mate. I would start with candidates from SOLDIER. These would of course include S and G types. Quite frankly, there's no telling what kind of properties a crossbred specimen might possess. So— What say you all?", 'Something stinks.', 'So first... Hmm, or perhaps instead... ', 'This one. This is definitely the one.', 'Hmm... ', 'Wait a minute.', "Yes, yes. Why didn't I think of that earlier?", "Wait, wait. You mustn't overthink it.", 'What is this?', "You must be the ones who've been stirring up trouble lately. The eco-terrorists? If so I can't imagine what business you have with me. The president's upstairs. Go on, shoo.", 'Do stop pushing. Unlike you, I am less accustomed to physical violence.', 'What is it that you want?', 'Really?', "Oh, so she's your friend... Well well well, in that case... Yes... That might do the trick.", "It's nothing. Just imagining how she might react if I were to present to her your fresh corpses. (laughs) I promise... you will regret this.", 'Very impressive. I really must thank you for providing me such invaluable combat data.', 'The results provided by my predictive models... indicate that this force should be more than capable of handling you.', 'Oh? "Take her back," you say? Correct me if I am wrong, but did the girl not come here of her own free will? Or do you mean to tell me that she is your "personal property"?', "I'm afraid you misunderstand. But I really can't be bothered to explain. This facility is home to extraordinary specimens that will change the world as we know it. Do try to be considerate.", 'Yes... an unknown variable, perhaps. Well, no matter. Reinforcements will soon arrive.', 'My, are you a SOLDIER?', "No, not quite. Oh, now I recall. My memory was mistaken. My boy, you weren't a SOLDIER... ", "What!? What is this—fascinating phenomenon!? What's happening!? Where are you taking me!?", 'Ahem. Can you all hear me?', " So tell me. How are you finding the Drum? You know it's filled with the most advanced technology in Midgar, if not the entire world. You should feel honored to see it firsthand! You'll also have the opportunity to take part in a rather ambitious experiment of mine.", "When all the pieces are in place, I will open the door to the 3rd ward. Perhaps you can help me with the necessary preparations? Given that you're already in the perfect position to do so. I look forward to data both invaluable and instrumental.", "I hope you're enjoying your experience.", 'Before you get any ideas, you should know this glass is bulletproof. No discernable changes after contact. Most fascinating. Hmm... ', "I never grow tired of watching my toys be broken, no matter how many times I've seen it happen. Such is the case when you truly enjoy your work. Now, for the next step... ", 'Hmph. They never learn.', "Again you triumph! (laughs) I'd be disappointed if you didn't! Yes... I believe I have just about all the data that I require. Then we are ready to proceed to the next stage."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['A fascinating question.', 'You asked what "it" is. Hmm... I am that which you see before you. Nothing more. I\'d appreciate it if we simply left it at that. Agreed?', '"Red XIII." The designation given to me by Hojo.', "I'm the one who carried you here.", "Don't thank me.", "Whispers. Perhaps best described as arbiters of fate. They are drawn to those who attempt to alter destiny's course and ensure they do not.", 'The flow of the great river that is the planet, from inception to oblivion.', 'Yes. For it is the will of the planet itself.', "I'm not a rat dog. When Aerith reached out to me... I found this knowledge of the Whispers.", 'Then we can use the same elevator that Hojo did.', 'Yes. His odor still lingers.', 'It stinks in here.', 'Back there.', 'The one thing we can.', "Hojo's treasure. Shinra's dark secret.", 'Need a hand?', 'You okay?', 'Nowhere close.', 'What is it?', 'Hm. I may be able to do that.', 'Yes.', 'Will this do the trick?', "That's not far from the truth.", "What's the plan?", "I think there's something over there.", "Now it's my turn.", "There's no control panel. We don't have the means to go this way.", 'Hojo.', "I'm afraid not. If I know Hojo, he won't let us out until we indulge his request for data.", 'The central terminal. Interesting.', 'The cataclysm that came from the stars—Jenova. Hojo has devoted half of his life to her study.', "The experiments in this facility... involve the enhancement of life-forms and machines through the application... of Jenova biological data. Hojo's plan is to pit his subjects against ust, thereby facilitating their growth.", 'I know what fate awaits these creations. Let us put them out of their misery.', 'We must first find a passage that leads to the center.', 'Off I go.', "There's no control panel. We don't have the means to go this way.", 'There are four switches. One for each ward.', 'You need to warn the others. Tell them to be careful. Very careful.', 'We need to open the door first.', ' It stinks.', 'It seems we have no choice.', 'Sorry. He got away.', "Test subjects don't receive treatment.", 'And he remembers us, I think.', "I don't see any elevators around here.", "If we want to get in, we'll need to go all the way back to the central terminal.", 'Dammit!', 'I am now.', 'Actually, they just found the entrance to the 4th ward. But to unlock it, they have to access the central terminal—which they cannot do from their position.', "Now it's my turn.", 'The professor still has plans for us, I presume.', 'All that remains is the 4th ward. We must trust in Cloud and Barret to see it through.', "There's only one thing we can do. We need to head to the 4th ward, just like he wants.", 'I hear something.', "There's an elevator just over there. But it will move only at Hojo's discretion.", "It appears Hojo's done having his fun.", 'We may find out soon.', "The president's office. And then the roof.", "The elevator back there can take us down to the central terminal again. Now's the time for any unfinished business.", 'Wait. I can hear something.', 'This is... ', "It's an illusion. Stay calm.", 'You okay?', 'This death was not the one ordained for you by fate.', 'Think they can manage on their own?', 'Hey.', 'Hey!', 'Get ready.', 'Now! Its right arm!', 'Take cover behind debris!', "Then let's finish this quick.", 'Stop its attack!', 'Quite. But we could still die later tonight. Cloud and Tifa could be dead already.', 'Then we need to find a way we can all escape—and quickly.', 'Lab rat dog!', "I wouldn't celebrate just yet.", 'Look.', "They're coming.", 'Careful—stay out of the line of fire.', 'Circle around to the other side.', 'Cloud, here!', "I hate to spoil the celebration, but... there's more.", 'Its guard is down. Now!', 'Cloud, you all right?', 'Cloud, you okay?', 'The Whispers intervene not to defend us, but to preserve the flow of destiny.', 'Says the three hundred pound sack of it.', 'Cloud!', 'With pleasure.', "Is it our destiny to defy destiny? It's an interesting question.", 'Will there be Whispers on the other side?', "This could well be her last line of defense. It won't be easy.", 'A glimpse of tomorrow if we fail here today.', 'Well, the big one is way over there. However... ', 'I decide my destiny.', "If it's to be a hunt, you could use a nose like mine."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['At least let us issue a warning, sir.', "Yes. Every reactor, every pillar. Like I said... a full inspection. There's no telling what kind of damage there might be. If you see anything—anything out of the ordinary, I want to know.", "No, it's fine.", "No, not yet. I need to finish preparing my draft of the reconstruction plan before tonight's board meeting. Whatever reasons they might've had, destroying an entire sector is... ... It's beyond the pale.", "Don't I know it... ", 'Welcome to the Shinra Building. Our mission here at Urban Planning is to supply the residents of Midgar with energy created from mako. We also take pride in maintaining public infrastructure—the pillars and railways that run all throughout the city. Currently, we are working to construct an intra-plate expressway. When this project has been completed, it will provide much easier access to numerous locations all across Midgar. We appreciate your patience and understanding in the meantime.', 'Mister President!', 'Please, sir!', 'At least let us issue a warning, sir.']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Hang back. We're not in any hurry.", "I'll see myself in, thanks. And who are you?", 'A SOLDIER?', "Well whaddya know, you've got the eyes at least.", "Well, you're weird enough to be one... What class?", " If you're gonna bullshit me, at least try to make it believable... ", 'Ooh!', "Bodyguard, huh? You know I'm hers too, right?", "'Cause it was a classified op, princess.", 'Ugh... Hey! Little help in here, guys?', "Good ol' what's-his-face. Hardly knew ya.", "Hate doing cleanup, but... I'm damn good at it!", "Whatcha waiting for, bodyguard? I'm right here!", "C'mere, SOLDIER boy. I won't bite.", "Gonna make me work for it, huh? Well, lucky for you—tough guy... I'm a consummate professional!", 'Figured this dance of ours could use a spark!', 'Oooh. Feeling all right there, mister bodyguard?', 'Not so tough now, are you!', 'Yoo-hoo! SOLDIER boy!', "Don't tell me you're trying to cut and run.", 'Heads up!', "I'm fine! Go get the girl.", 'Hey! No shooting!', "If there's so much as a scratch on her... you're done.", 'We bring her in in one piece.', 'What now?', "Oh no, you won't!", "What's the holdup!?", 'Huh. Some kind of magic trick?', 'Stop her!', "Nah. Leave 'em be.", "Partner's got it. We. Are. Out. Beginner's luck.", "Hey there, partner. I'm sure you're having the time of your life, but we're needed on standby for a job. Something about Sector 7. So get your ass back here now.", 'This is bullshit. What the hell are they thinking?', "Guess it's a little late to grow a conscience. ... Meh.", "Yeah, yeah, of course I do! We can drop the damn thing whenever... It's just that... ", "You got a death wish or something? Because I sure as shit don't.", 'Not really. Small arms fire from some local boys trying to defend the pillar.', "So that's what we are, huh?", "Testing, testing... Attention, Avalanche scum! We know all about your evil plans to destroy the pillar. But the Turks—ahem! But Shinra—that's us—won't let you get away with it! So go crawl back into whatever hole you crawled out of, or something!", 'That oughta do it, right?', 'Wait. I know you... Mister "First Class." (chuckles) First-class asshole! Gotcha now! You ain\'t got nowhere to run!', 'Man, screw this cheap-ass play.', 'Pop your head out and let me finish this already.', 'Two birds with one shitload of bullets!', 'Hey!', 'Dammit! You wanna explain yourself, partner?', "And where do you think you're going? Come out, come out, wherever the hell you are!", 'Save us all some time and give up.', 'I see you!', 'Wassup, guys!', "Well, if this is how you wanna play it, that's fine by me.", 'Stay where I can see ya!', 'Man, you suck at hiding!', ' Yeah, you better run!', 'You still want some more?', 'How do you assholes like *this*?', "I don't know about you, but I am *over* this shit!", 'Looks like you guys are having the time of your life.', 'What, what?', 'Huh? Our guys are seriously struggling to take down these assholes?', "Whatever you say, partner. Keep 'em busy, will ya?", 'Time for a rematch, huh... Rude!', "It's nothing personal... bitch! Ha!", 'Missed me!', 'Sorry, losers! Gotta play for keeps today. No time to dick around.', 'Yeah, yeah, coming right up.', "No you don't! Not when I'm working!", "Now, now... You ain't got shit on us.", 'Ha! In your dreams.', 'So. Heard you gave Rude a beating.', "No choice, huh? I guess I ain't got one neither.", "Stubborn little shitbirds, ain'tcha?", 'Say what!?', "I see you're doin' whatever the hell you want. Guess I'm rubbing off on ya.", 'Dammit... ', ' Clipped your wings, huh?', "Any landing ya can walk away from... C'mon! Let's teach 'em the Turks two-step!", "What happens when you mess with the Turks! If you're gonna pick a fight with the Turks, you'd better be prepared to leave in a body bag.", 'Rude!', 'Who knows?', "Nah, I'm good... ", 'Yeah... nope.', 'Say what?', 'Sure you wanna do this personally, boss?']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Well, hello!', '"Too quick for the eye, you cross him, you die!" Now... Mind if I cut in? Woo! Splendid! I\'ve been looking for a new dance partner!', "Private party, huh? That's fine. I'll settle for a race then. Just one.", 'I most certainly am.', 'Ah, so terribly sorry! Your words fail to reach my ears, sluggish and slow as they are!', "The lady's curiosity has been piqued! My name is Roche, but you may address me by the more accurate appellation: Speed Demon!", 'My ears are attuned to the feminine voice!', "Yes. Yes! This is the contest I've been waiting for!", 'Fascinating... ', "Not bad. You have promise, and an abiding affection for your mount. But! One cannot simply ride one's bike! Nay! One must unlock its true potential—become one with the machine! Like this!", "Don't be absurd. As if I could ever grow tired of your company!", 'Naughty, naughty! Until one of our flames is forever extinguished, our dance will never end! (laughs) Burn for me!', "Come on! Let's push it past the redline!", 'Well, well, well! I do believe this round is yours. (chuckles) Maybe next time we can keep it just between the two of us.', ' Until we meet again, my friend!', " Well, aren't we having a wonderful time kicking the hornet's nest!", 'You know what I want. A second dance—just the two of us.', 'You turned the key... The engine roars with excitement... It hungers to be set free!', "It's been a long time since I fought a duel out of the saddle. But... for all the miles on the clock... ", "I'm just as fast as I ever was!", "At last, our long-awaited dance begins! Here's to a fair fight, my friend!", 'I told you we were gonna push it past the redline!', ' With such fleeting pleasure? Hardly. There are higher heights to which you and I can still soar... ', "We really must do this again. Until then... try not to die. I'll see you on the road, my friend.", "Hahahahahahahahaha! I'm waiting, my friend! Come out, come out, wherever you are!", "Don't by shy! I simply wanna finish what we started!", "Why, hello there! Forgive me for saying, but you remind me of a dear friend of mine. Perhaps you've met him?", 'Perhaps, perhaps... My name is Roche, by the way. Ordinarily, your ill-concealed hostility and exotic wardrobe would give me pause. But not today, for I am here on business of a *personal* nature. Looking for my aforementioned friend.', 'Oh, I only wish I knew! But I *can* tell you that he has a real... "need for speed," as they say. And while he boasts a *very* large sword, his first love his plainly his mount!', "I'm always ready for a round of Fort Condor!", 'Though... I suspect a delicate flower like you would wither if exposed to my scorching passion for the game. Maybe after some practice, hm?', ' In the absence of my friend, you will provide some much-needed entertainment, my dear!', "Well played, my friend! And to think I thought I'd best you easily!", "But of course! With that display of passion, you've more than proven yourself worthy! Henceforth, you shall occupy a place in the pantheon of my closest companions! When next we meet, it will be on the open road, the wind in our hair... Just don't make me come looking for you, my friend!", 'Hahahahahaha! Nice try, but no.']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Never seen you before.', "Hah! You're not serious, are you? Look at him! He's a scrawny little thing. I could snap him like a twig!", "Ha! You're taking me on? You look like a dried-up old terpsicolt left out in the sun. You got no idea what you're getting into, little man.", "Now don't go crying to mommy.", "How—? How the hell did I lose to this scrawny little kid who looks like he doesn't even consume his daily recommended amount of protein?", 'Just how much training do you do!?', "You're better than I thought!", 'I believe in you!', "Oh, man! Who's gonna win this one? It's too close to tell!", 'You got it, Jules!', 'Andi... ', "I'm worried about Andi. He's gonna push himself too far.", 'But my god, when I look at that magnificent physique of his... ', 'Looking to work up a sweat?', 'You here to test your muscular mettle against mine?', "Today's another great day to feel the burn!", "What're you looking at me for? Oh, you here to take me on, are you? Bring it on."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Hello, Aerith.', "Haven't seen him before. He your new boy toy?", 'Wait a minute... Those eyes... Is he the one who beat up Reno?', "Need to cross my T's, dot my I's. That's all.", "No, I'm not bad. But like it or not... I sometimes have to do bad things. Don't take it personal.", "You're one to talk!", 'Stay back.', 'No.', 'Gotta get a little payback for my partner.', 'Hmph. SOLDIER huh?', 'Okay then.', "No, I don't believe that I have.", "Can't. It's my job.", "I've seen his type before.", 'Oh, better than expected.', "I thought you didn't wanna get rough.", "You know I can't do that.", 'Understood.', '... Apparently so.', 'Go home and stay there.', 'Huh?', "... Understood. The Avalanche mission's been approved. We are to proceed as planned.", '"Threats to public order are to be summarily put down." This is what we\'ve always done.', 'Eh. Good enough.', 'Throw down your weapon and surrender! Shinra does not negotiate with terrorists!', 'Stairs.', 'Uh... Hand slipped.', "Seems we've lost control of the top floor.", 'Anyway, we may need to intervene personally.', 'Prepping for bombing run, how copy?', 'I was planning to join you anyway.', 'Time for you to learn... ', 'Reno!', 'Five minutes to go.', 'What are we going to do about Sector 7?', 'Been thinking. Was all that necessary?', 'Do you actually believe that?', 'Understood.']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["You're a SOLDIER, aren't you? Which, of course, would mean that I own you.", 'Secure the others. Just the two of us. Well. Maybe three.', "Don't say that.", 'Hmph. Not bad.', 'Okay.', "Not at all. You're making me sweat. Good thing I came prepared.", "Like it? 'Course you do.", "Let's make it a night to remember.", 'Yeah. You should be honored.', 'No, not quite. Tonight marks a new beginning for Shinra!', 'What is all this?', 'Bring them in.', "That's right."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["Oh hey, Cloud! You're just in time for our favorite game—Whack-a-Box! You want in? It's super fun! The rules are easy. The person who whacks the most boxes is crowned champion of the hideout! We usually don't let adults play, but since you're cool, we're gonna make a special exception just for you.", "See? Pretty fun, right? Play with us again, 'kay!", 'Holy cow! You crushed it!', 'Wanna play some Whack-a-Box?', 'Only one way to become a Whack-a-Box master: whack, whack, whack!']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Move.', 'Mako Reactor 5 has been temporarily shut down, and all fires have been successfully extinguished. The situation is under control, and the people of our fair city need not worry about any additional complications. We are in the process of conducting a full forensic investigation. But we suspect the device used was similar to that employed in the attack on Mako Reactor 1.', 'The perpetrators of that atrocity were filmed making their escape. These agents of the eco-terrorist group Avalanche are currently believed to be hiding somewhere in Midgar... ', 'What do *you* think?', 'Have no fear. Shinra *will* keep Midgar safe.', 'Stop. Your timing is impeccably atrocious.', 'Now... Show me something truly exquisite!', "We're leaving.", 'Clean up the mess, would you?', 'Two words, Reeve: "Neo Midgar." Hm.', "Personally, I've never had a problem with torture.", 'Mako Reactor 5 has been temporarily shut down, and all fires have been successfully extinguished. The situation is under control, and the people of our fair city need not worry about any additional complications. We are in the process of conducting a full forensic investigation. But we suspect the device used was similar to that employed in the attack on Mako Reactor 1.', 'Perfect. Just perfect. Hm?', " But oh, how the mighty are fallen—Wutai... colluding with Avalanche and resorting to terrorism? Hm. I always thought the Wutaians an honorable people. They used to be, certainly... But now? Now they're nothing but blood-sucking flies, buzzing around Shinra's face.", 'Would you not agree? In light of recent events, I mean.', 'What a lovely smile.', "My god, you people are deadly boring. Luckily, I know exactly how to liven things up... with a little experiment. Just don't go dying on me—that wouldn't yield very interesting results, now would it?", 'Credit where credit is due. You exceeded my every expectation. And for being such good sports... you may now leave.', "And we'll let them. Meanwhile, find out what it is they want.", "You do have eyes, don't you? Then you can see that, while they are simpletons, they've made it further than any normal Wutaian ever could. Clearly, they are ninjas. *Teenage* ninjas. And they've come such a long way. We simply must roll out the red carpet. My trusty steed should provide a fitting welcome, I think. Keep me apprised, would you?", 'So—have you found out what they want yet?', 'Excuse me? You mean to say that these savages have gone to all this trouble for *materia*?', 'How very dull. Be that as it may, I suppose I should talk to them.', 'Enjoying yourselves, I trust?', 'Awed by a simple hologram? How precious. But I know just what you need—to loosen up a little. After such a long journey... you must be so tense!', 'Luckily, I have toys for that—all far more entertaining than this.', "Oh dear. Is that any way to talk to your host? Really though, as guests, it's more about what you want. And I think you'll find it just up ahead. Hurry now. Don't keep me waiting.", 'Welcome to our state-of-the-art weapons testing facility. This is where we push every piece of ordnance to its limits... and beyond. Such tests are an invaluable part of the development process. Go on, see where the magic happens.', 'My, my, how impressive! Seems I may have underestimated how resilient you ninjas can be.', " You Wutaians, so fesity. But let's see how you fare against what I have in store for you next. It's quite the treat, I assure you. Only the best for our honored guests, after all. Whenever you're ready.", "At long last, Wutai's finest deign to join us. You've performed admirably.", ' Is that so? Well, maybe I am!', 'Oh my! We must do something right away!', "Don't say that. Won't you at least give us a chance?", "Allow me to present... the latest innovation in Shinra battle armor... Designed by yours truly. This'll be a memory to cherish for the rest of your lives. All thirty seconds of them.", 'Rather rude to ignore your playmates, is it not?', "Oh, I will, my dear. But I rather suspect you'll wish that I hadn't.", 'A moment, if you please.', ' Pardon the wait.', 'Useless!', "Not nearly mobile enough. Should've known those actuators weren't up to the task. Time for an overhaul.", 'Hm?', ' Proud of yourself, little savage?', " Is this how it's done in Wutai? You just howl until you get what you want?", 'Well, well... Wutai must have some highly skilled intelligence operatives. That... or we have a mole in our midst.', "You *are* correct that we're in the process of creating an exquisite new materia. However, it is far from complete.", 'Would I lie to you? Regrettable though it is, other plans have been deemed a higher priority.', " Well... just between you and me... My colleagues and I... are going to drop Plate Number 7 on the slums. And then we're going to blame it on Avalanche and Wutai.", "Oh dear. I think your friend might've run into trouble. Aren't you going to save him?", 'I want them... to suffer.', 'The rest, I leave to you.']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['In the city that never sleeps!', 'Where your every desire can be indulged for the right price—Wall Market!', 'Are you sitting comfortably? For tonight, the most gruesome spectacle anywhere in Wall Market or beyond shall be yours to witness! Here in the Corneo Colosseum!', 'Thoroughly and utterly!', 'Without mercy!', 'Shall claim the gil and the glory!', "Warriors of every shape and size will fight to the death before your very eyes! In tonight's Corneooo Cuuup!", 'For our next match, we welcome two fighters—a young couple, no less!', 'This is their first tournmanet!', 'And most likely their last, inexperienced as they are—or are they!? Give it up for Cloud and Aerith!', "They've already been given their appetizer!", "We're in for a treat, ladies and gentlemen! Who will prevail in this brutal contest between man and beast!? This could be over in an instant, so don't even blink! Without further ado, the fourth match of the first round... begins now!", "Can you believe it!? I don't think anyone saw this coming!", 'And the winners of our match are... Cloud and Aerith!', 'For the second match in our spectacular semifinals... Fresh from their first date with death, I present... the lucky couple!', 'Give it up once again for Cloud and Aerith!', 'Ladies and gentlemen, check your pockets, because they may have already robbed you blind!', 'And who are these unscrupulous-looking gentlemen?', "This could be a real bloodbath! So I implore you, ladies and gentlemen—don't look away, or you may miss the best part!", "It was two against, uh, I don't remember who many exactly, but a lot! But somehow, the winners of our match are... Once again! Cloud and Aerith!", "Tonight's thrilling Corneo Cup–filled with unprecedented upsets and drama—has only one match to go!", "Once more—the sweethearts who've surprised us with upset after spectacular upset! The power couple with a boundless love for bloodshed! The champions of Madam M—Cloud and Aerith!", 'Along with a handful of maimings.', "The electric executioners... Chocobo Sam's champions... Cutty and Sweepy!", 'Who will walk away with the one-million-gil prize!? Get ready for a fight guaranteed to go down in history!', 'The final match of the Corneo Cup... begins now!', "Tonight's Corneo Cup has been a spectacle like no other. And we shared your disappointment, ladies and gentlemen, when we told you that it was coming to an end.", "Participating in this match will be this evening's leading lights—the dynamic duo that has crushed all competition thus far! Cloud and Aerith!", "The secret star of Don Corneo's stellar stable!", 'Enter: the Hell House!', 'You have not! No sir, you have not!', 'Keep your eyes glued to the action, ladies and gentlemen!', 'Begins... now!', 'This couple has fought the toughest of the tough, the meanest of the mean, but can they handle the horror of the Hell House!?', 'Let it wash over you—restore you inside and out!', 'Feel that raging fire! Can the Hell House weather the inferno!?', "Don't be fooled by their cute looks, because they're here to kick ass and take names!", "That frosty stare could strike a man dead where he stands. Maybe I'll be the lucky victim!", 'Will our big-boned birdie make a meal of the Hell House? Will he gobble it right up? Yum, yum, yum, yum, yum!', 'Hold on tight, ladies and gentlemen, for the fury of the ocean might swallow you whole!', 'I hope you have insurance, because safety is *not* guaranteed. None of us may make it out of here alive!', 'Cloud has seen better days! Can he keep fighting the good fight or is he ready to throw in the towel!?', "Ouch, that's gotta hurt. Aerith gets a double dose of neighborly hatred!", 'And Aerith is down for the count!', 'And Aerith is down for the count!', "I'm sorry, ladies and gentlemen, but this is painful to watch!", 'Batten down the hatches, folks, because a storm is brewing on the horizon!', 'And the winner, the man-eating monstrosity, the horror, the Hell House!', "Oof, that color is a dead giveaway! The architect must've had one too many when he designed this thing!", 'Ladies and gentlemen! What is happening!?', 'The Hell House is showing us its *true* paint job! How will Aerith and Cloud adapt?', "If you wanna know what's in the box, you'll just have to open it up and see!", "What is going on in there!? Only time will tell, but I'm not sure we wanna know!", "The Hell House isn't afraid to fight dirty!", 'Now that had to hurt, folks! Are these moves even legal!?', 'Now *that* is the price you pay for daring to get in the way of true love!', "The Hell House isn't afraid to fight dirty!", "There'll be no coming back from this one!", 'Another barrage of chaos coming in hot, folks! Will this turn the tide against them!?', "Where'd these chairs come from? Who do they belong to? Who needs all those chairs? I have so many questions!", "What's this? The ol' switcheroo? As usual, the Hell House is up to no good!", "They're bringing that high-flying house back down to earth!", 'Cloud and Aerith—they stand poised to win it all!', 'Cloud and Aerith!', 'Yeah... ', 'So, ladies. Ready to... get to it?', 'Wait... I know you... The colosseum!']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['I am?', 'Oh, you need not remind me. It was the crowning moment of our time together. But that was then, and this is now. I have a favor to ask.', 'Our beloved planet is dying. Slowly. Silently. Painfully. Can you bear to see the planet suffer... Cloud?', 'Were the planet to die, so many things would be lost. Your hometown that burns so bright... The sound of her voice pleading for me to spare you. The shiver of her flesh yielding to cold steel.', "That which binds us together would be no more. And I would be loath to live in such a world. Which is why I must ask you this one favor. Don't worry. It's a simple thing.", 'Run, Cloud... Run away. You have to leave... You have to live.', 'Good, Cloud. Very good. Hold on to that hatred.', 'You are too weak to save anyone. Not even yourself.', 'Sleep. And dream the sweetest dreams... ', 'I am... your everything.', "Oh, Cloud. There's still so much to be done.", 'The reunion... is nothing to fear.', 'Within my veins flows the blood of Ancients. This planet... is my birthright.', 'You have failed again, I see.', "But through suffering, you will grow strong. Isn't that what you want?", 'Mother. I have come for you.', 'Mother. Together we can reclaim our world.', 'Mother. They have come again.', 'Mother. The days have come again.', 'Mother... Together we will reclaim our world.', "Don't deny me. Embrace me.", 'A touching reunion.', 'Those who look with clouded eyes see nothing but shadows.', 'All born are bound to her. Should this world be unmade, so too shall her children.', 'Listen.', 'Destiny come.', "I'm waiting, Cloud.", "I'm waiting, Cloud.", 'Fate is not to be taken lightly, Cloud.', 'Have we forgotten already?', 'The planet will claim you.', 'Do I frighten you?', 'Will you weep for me?', 'Begone.', 'Away.', 'Leave.', 'Fools.', 'Can you not see your future?', 'What hope have you?', 'You cannot change it.', 'The weakness within.', 'Careful now. That which lies ahead... does not yet exist.', 'Our world will become a part of it... one day. But I... will not end. Nor will I have you end.', 'The edge of creation. Cloud, lend me your strength. Let us defy destiny... together.', "Not yet. Seven seconds till the end. Time enough for you. Perhaps. But what will you do with it? Let's see."]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["They've yet to announce it publicly, but I heard it was Avalanche's doing.", 'J-just who do you think you are?', 'We will not submit to intimidation or violence! But work together for peace and prosperity! That is how civilized people change the world!', "It's what we believe. We all have to follow our conscience, don't we?", "So do you *still* support those terrorists? Avalanche is a blight on Midgar. Their bomb threat has thrown our offices into chaos, let alone the reactor itself. It's total insanity! But we won't lose heart! No! Everyone at Shinra agrees. The reactor will stay online!", 'What? You got a problem with that?', 'I know nothing more to say to you and your friend.', "The Sector 4 offices got the worst of it. Everyone's panicking over there.", 'Just leave me alone.', 'Wh—what are you doing!?', "But I work for Shinra. I'm the enemy.", "I'll look after the others.", 'So the key to victory is ensuring that your units—Wait. What was a unit again... ?', "And then there's formations and placement... Who came up with this stuff?", 'So when your opponent leads with this, you respond with... this? This game is insane... ', "Oh! Sorry, I didn't mean to disturb anyone. My daughter's been dying to play this game, and I promised to teach her. But first, I have to teach myself.", "Y-you will? Uh, thanks, that'd be a great help.", "Well, whaddya know! I think I'm startin' to get the hang of this!", 'Losing on purpose, to be precise. If I can let my daughter win without her suspecting, that to me is as good as a victory.', " I know, I know... But if it'll make her happy... "]

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ["I'm back.", "Sorry 'bout that.", 'Well, I don\'t even know where to begin with all of that... But I *do* know I haven\'t heard of "Operation Down-in-One." At any rate, I\'m looking forward to working with you, Boss.', "Well, I've got a few years on you, I'll admit—but out of us two, you've done this longer.", 'After we get that materia, we can celebrate your promotion at the Happy Turtle.', 'So Nayo, where we headed?', "Put the claws away, Boss. Least while we're in Shinra territory.", 'Whoa.', 'Gotta agree with you about the smell, but you get used to it quick enough.', "Nah, better not. After what they've done, you gotta assume Shinra's on their tail. Should keep our distance.", "Gotta admit, I'm surprised you agreed to work with us.", "In other words, you're working with us so we don't work with your old buddies—knowing what would happen if we did.", "And not just that. By sneaking into Shinra HQ and snatching their most prized possession from under their noses... not only will we deal a massive blow to their morale... but we'll prove to them that while Wutai might be down, we're not out. That the gist of it, Boss?", 'Hey, at least you tried.', "I thought it looked seedy. Guess you'd *have* to be a scumbug to build a place like that.", 'I saw it while I was scouting the area.', "Just another one of Shinra's victims.", "Not yet, Boss. With things the way they are, we can't just go strolling up to the front gates. We're gonna need Avalanche to help us bypass security before we can do anything.", 'The *S7* pillar?', "Why's he need us to hurry? I don't like the sound of this.", 'More like a mutant.', "You're right. Hold up.", 'We gotta help.', 'That way.', 'Boss. We might not be back for a while. Best to stock up before leaving.', 'Whatever it was, he probably did it for us.', 'No time for that, Boss.', "We don't have time to get into that, Boss. You can ask him yourself once he's safe. Come on.", "She's a local, remember. She'll be fine.", 'Yeah. I can imagine.', 'Wait—Boss! No!', 'You gotta learn to think before ya act, Boss. Gonna get yourself killed one of these days.', "I've got an idea about that, but let's get to a vantage point first.", "Alright, see that massive structure up ahead? That's the pillar those troopers were talking about. Assuming the maintenance facility's near there, we should probably head toward it. Sound good?", "C'mon.", 'Hey, about what you said earlier.', "About Avalanche—how it's changed.", "These people are too soft. But those splinter cell guys? *They* sound like the ones we should've teamed up with. Don'tcha think?", "I feel bad for complaining, considering all they've done for us.", "And that's the problem. Midgar doesn't need good people. Not that we care what happens to it.", "Hey, Boss... Wanna try treading a little lighter this time? No point fighting if we don't have to.", ' Why me?', 'Pillar maintenance. It has to be.', "I think you know exactly why. Gotta say, they might call this place a maintenance facility... but it looks more like an arms factory to me. Let's keep it tight, Boss. We can't afford any more mistakes. Zhijie's life depends on it.", 'Ready to do this, Boss?', "Great. I'll draw their attention. You grab our guy.", 'Award-winning performance, Boss.', 'Centipede model, huh?', 'Boss!', 'Drones? What does it need *them* for?', "There's missiles.", "By not letting it launch 'em.", "This'll make thigns easier.", 'Boss!', 'Wait, what?', 'Looks like it wants to get serious.', "That's how ninjas do it.", "Yeah. Next time, I'm buying. I'll show you how Wutaians really party.", "Well, Boss, sounds like we'd better get going. Let's head up as soon as you're ready.", "Prob'ly best if we don't stick around. Let's catch the train.", "Boss. I don't think we'll be back here anytime soon, so make sure you're ready for anything, okay?", 'Gonna be sick?', "Melphie always got motion sick. Chocobos, boats... Sure trains would've done it too.", 'My sister.', 'She trained under your father at the same time as me. And she had such promise... ', 'The war was ending... But a Shinra mech went haywire near a crowd, and... she had to do something.', "They deserve what's comin' to 'em.", 'Whoa, look at all these people... ', "Elevators're right there. Let's catch one.", 'The basement. Advanced Weaponry.', "Dammit! I'll never get a better chance. That was Scarlet, director of Advanced Weaponry. It was one of *her* machines that killed Melphie!", "Right, Boss... I'm sorry.", 'Where *did* she send us?', 'It sounds like you are, too.', "Wonder how he's holding up... ", "That's my master you're talking about. Mind laying off him a little?", 'Ecstatic.', 'And... go!', "Might be the power. That thing's off too.", "Maybe—but they're not what we came for. Let's keep movin', Boss.", 'Easy now. Focus. Ah, I know. Spare a Da-chao bean?', 'You sound surprised.', 'Likewise.', 'Yeah, same here.', 'Right. Shall we?', "Might still be worth a shot. Could be something in it for us. Just... be careful, 'kay?", 'It does look more important than the others... ', 'What do you want!?', "So, Boss. What're you thinking?", 'Couldna said it better myself.', 'We better hope not, boss.', 'But not for much longer, eh, Boss?', "What're you doing!?", "What'd you do? Tell us!", "I'll check on it.", 'There you are!', 'No clue. They just appeared!', 'Just hit me with it.', "They're gonna do *what*?", "But that's the whole upper part of the sector!", 'This is bad.', 'Right behind ya! We may not have that materia, but we do have good intel.', "That's the spirit. Let 'em have it!", 'Huh?', 'Yuffie!', 'Somehow, I seriously doubt it... ', "Meaning we're trapped.", "They figure we need a challenge. Meaning we're in for a world of hurt.", "There's gotta be a projection mechanism around here somewhere. If we can just find it... ", 'Boss!', "Cause that tentacled freak won't let you. We're gonna have to tough this one out.", "Boss, the projector! While it's down!", "Who could've done this?", "Let's take a different tack.", 'Careful. This "freak\'s" no pushover.', "Now, Boss. While he's distracted!", "Sonon, help! Get this creep off'a me!", 'Boss!', "Stay focused. We'll get through this.", "Agreed. Let's get outta here.", "Let's end this before it swallows us too.", 'Aaah! Gah... Raaah!', 'Not my finest moment.', "Now, Boss! Let's finish this!", 'We did.', "Don't wanna spoil the moment, but... we should prob'ly get going.", 'I could carry you.', 'Go... ', 'Please.', 'Yuffie... . You gotta keep going... for *us*.', 'Damn... ', 'Melphie... ']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Cloud! Are you ignoring me!?', 'Marlene!', 'Welcome back!', 'You made it.', "Where'd you get that? I can't remember the last time I saw a real one.", 'How sweet. When did *you* get so thoughtful?', 'Huh?', 'Right. Come on in.', "Do you mind keeping Marlene company until I'm done with this?", 'Yeah, you.', 'So, then! What can I get you?', 'Ah... Right... About that... We should talk. Outside.', "Before we get onto money... There's an empty apartment in a place just down the road. It's nothing fancy, but... I was thinking you could stay there for now. The landlady's a big friend of the cause, so you wouldn't even have to pay rent! Sound good?", 'Follow me then!', 'How was it up on the plate?', "Sorry for dragging you into all this. It was wrong of me to put you in danger like that. I promise I won't do it again.", "I'll try not to.", 'So, you make nice with everyone?', "Good. You had me worried. You're not exactly a people person.", 'I saw Sector 8 on the news... It was like a war zone... ', "So... it wasn't that bad?", 'Oh. Right.', "And here we are. Good ol' Stargazer Heights. You're on the second floor.", 'Do you need some alone time or something?', 'Hey, Cloud! This way!', "Stick with me for now. I'll give you the grand tour later.", "It's not my fault if you get lost.", 'Cloud—come on!', "Uh... that's not the way.", "Room 201 here is where I sleep. Don't have time for much else, what with Seventh Heaven and all. Not even time to decorate.", "Here's your room—202. Don't worry, I already told the landlady about you.", 'Yes? Ohhh, I mean I told her I had a friend looking for a place to stay. Was that too much?', "That one's, uh... Know what, it's getting late. I'll introduce you tomorrow.", "I do, and we'd love to settle up, especially since this was your first job for us, but... ", "Sorry. We spent the rest preparing for the mission. That really is it. But not for long! I'm collecting money for filters tomorrow, so I can pay you after.", "Of course... as long as you help, that is. Wait... Then I'd have to pay you for that too. Never mind.", "You're the best! I'll see you bright and early at the bar, then. Thanks again for everything. Sleep tight!", 'Cloud! Stop!', "What are you doing to Marco? This is his apartment. He's got a few problems, but he's not a bad guy. The landlady asked me to check on him now and then to make sure he's okay. Can I ask you to do the same?", 'Morning!', "Just so you know, Marlene's still asleep.", "Let's get down to business, shall we? These water filters won't replace themselves. Although, the next batch probably *could*, if Jessie put her mind to it. Most every home in the area has one. Folks love 'em 'cause they practically eliminate the rotten-egg smell. Honestly, they make us more money than this place. And it's easy money too. We bring new filters, collect the old ones, and get paid.", 'What?', 'Which is why no one will refuse to pay. What do you say? Please?', "Great. And while we're at it, I'll give you the grand tour.", "Go ahead and keep whatever we collect.
