Seeing as you didn't bring any luggage, I'm guessing there's stuff you need to buy.", "And don't worry. We'll pay you the difference after. Barret's out making his rounds too.", 'Hey, there. Here to change out your water filter.', "Cloud's in charge of collections. He'll take your money.", "Cloud! Uh... since we're here, maybe we should do a little shopping?", "We'll see you around, okay? And let us know when your filter next needs changing!", "He's a regular. Stock up here and he might throw in a freebie or two.", 'Well... You could try being a little nicer.', " Our next stop is Stargazer Heights. Landlady's a client.", "Then you know what to expect. Remember: she's a good friend of Avalanche, so be nice. Please.", 'Hey, Marle! Got some filters for you.', "Be nice! Cloud's helping me with collections.", "I'm pretty good at taking care of myself, you know.", 'Be nice!', 'A tried-and-true lesson for life on the ground floor, am I right?', 'Thanks, Marle. You take care of yourself.', "Marle's great. She helped get me set up back in the day.", "Five years, give or take... But never mind that! We've gotta get you your money! Last stop is the weapon store.", "We're so sorry about that. Hopefully this one will work better... ", "All right. If you could just settle your bill, we'll be on our way.", 'My associate handles payment disputes... ', 'Thank you very much!', "Seeing as we're done with our rounds, and you've got a small fortune now, why not take a gander at the weapons?", "Before we open up tonight. It'll be a while yet, so... what do you wanna do?", 'In that case, I\'ve got a suggestion. Wanna hear it? If you\'re serious about becoming a merc, then you\'re going to need to start making connections. "It\'s not what you know, but who you know," y\'know?', 'Yep. Connections get you jobs, jobs build your rep, and more rep gets you better connections... ', "Hmm... why not help out the neighborhood watch? They're mostly volunteers, but you'll get to know people.", "Didn't see anybody at the office, so let's head up top.", "Huh, didn't know you were holding down the fort.", "Cloud's a great fighter, but only we know that. If no one knows him, no one'll hire him. Thought if he joined the watch, he could get his name out there.", "Between him and Wedge, there isn't anyone they don't know.", "Hey, Cloud. I'll come with.", "But... you don't know the way, do you?", ' Sure thing. I know these streets better than anyone.', 'Scrap Boulevard is out west. Past the barricades supposed to keep the monsters out. Anyway, we should prepare, just in case.', "Here's Scrap Boulevard.", 'Hm. And the more we pile up, the more they show up.', "And there's our first challenger! Show me what you got, Cloud!", "Wow... So that's what a SOLDIER looks line in action.", " I'll bet. Let's keep at it!", "You're good at this! Charging in like it was nothing... ", 'Well, I\'ve been here five years now. "If you don\'t look out for yourself, no one else will." By the way—that one\'s gonna be on the test.', "Gotta learn if you're gonna stick around. Okay, let's wrap this up... ", 'Alright. I think that might be the last of them.', "Of course not. Even so, folks'll be grateful for the peace and quiet in the meantime. A win's a win, you know?", "Trust me—it'll do wonders for your rep. Right, let's go check in with Biggs and Wedge.", 'Got every last one too. Now the slums should be safe.', "It's alright. All you gotta do is keep up the good work. It'll pay off soon enough, I promise.", 'You okay?', 'Been meaning to ask... After you left the village... ', "I've got time! Why don't you tell me all about it while we try to rustle up some more work for you?", 'Sorry. Maybe next time.', "Hey, before we get back to it, why don't you check out the weapons?", "C'mon, the dealer's probably heard all about you by now. Might treat you better.", 'Word spreads fast around here.', "Since you've got yourself a new weapon, let's see if we can't put it to good use. Come on. Let's go chat up Wymer.", 'The guy who tracks all the requests that come to the watch. You never know—could toss some work your way.', 'Oh, he should be back at the office by now.', "Actually, I wanted to introduce you to an old friend of mine. This is Cloud. He's a merc.", "Something's wrong. Let's check it out.", "That went well. Could be you've found your calling.", 'Think of each job as an opportunity—not to make money, but to build connections.', ' You remembered.', 'Maybe not so patient next time.', "Oh, Barret should've finished collecting his share of the money by now, so what do you wanna do? Head back to the bar?", 'Oh, so you want more of a challenge, huh?', "Okay then! That's another solid gig in the books! You know the whole town is really impressed with what you've done. Keep it up and you'll have enough work to keep you fed for a lifetime!", "And don't you forget it!", "Yeah, but why don't we head back to the apartments first? Take a quick breather.", "Lesson one. Got it? Anyway, let's go!", "Hmm, what do you think? Should we wait? You know, this might be a waste of time. Let's head back to the store and touch base for now.", 'No.', 'I know someone who can help you. This guy right here.', "Wait. Did you hear that just now? I think one of Betty's cats might be nearby.", "Ah! That was definitely a cat. I wonder if it's one of Betty's.", 'That the key?', 'Sure thing!', "Let's take care of this real quick, okay?", "Come over when you're done.", "Gimme one sec. I'll be done in a bit.", 'Finally!', 'So. After you left the village.', 'I let you off the hook before. Back at the hall. But not this time.', 'Yeah, I remember they were on the news every day during the war.', "I'm sorry. I know it's a touchy subject.", "I get it. Still, it's kinda funny. Us going our separate ways, thinking that must be it... that we'd never meet again—and then here of all places we do.", "You know what? We should totally celebrate! Let's dress up and hit the town!", "I mean, why not? It'll be fun!", "Not like *fancy* fancy, but I'll figure something out! What do you think would suit me, huh?", "Yeah, I guess we're not kids anymore.", "I don't think that'd be so different from my usual.", "Uhhh... really? Then again, if we're making an effort... ", 'Be sure to pick an outfit that goes with mine, okay?', " This is gonna be so much fun, you'll see!", "And on that happy note, I think it's time we headed back to the bar. C'mon!", "Honestly, I'm feeling pretty good. Marle isn't always right you know.", "Hey, Marle. We took care of the filters, so we're gonna head back to the bar now.", "Uh... I don't feel that different.", "What's going on?", "We've gotta save him, Cloud!", "No. He doesn't really know what we do... but he has his suspicions. And... He's a talker.", 'Actually, you know what... maybe I should go alone.', 'Uh... are you sure?', 'Thanks. Come on!', "Come on. Let's get a closer look.", 'I swear, all he had to do was keep his mouth shut.', "Anyway, you distract the officers, and I'll... figure something out.", 'Here we go... ', 'Grab Johnny so we can get outta here.', 'Wh—what now?', 'No!', "I know, but... it's fine.", "No more... Cloud... You're scaring me.", 'We need to go before they wake up.', "I... I'm worried about Johnny.", 'Right... ', "It's just... you've really changed.", "I suppose it's... yeah. Your eyes. They used to be less... ", '... I remember. So, what do you wanna do now? Head back to the bar? Or do you wanna tackle another job or two?', 'And here we are. You must be tired.', 'Could use a little something to take the edge off, right? How about a refreshing cocktail made by yours truly that you can sit back and savor?', "Yeah, I'm feeling it a bit too. Hey... Do you think you'll stick around a little longer?", 'I see. In that case, wanna head back out and look for more gigs?', 'Well? You wanna head inside?', "We're back.", 'Lotsa fun.', 'Uh... right now? Then the plan is... ?', "Looks like we're officially on for tomorrow night, then. Gotta go over the details with the others.", "I'm really sorry... but it shouldn't take much longer. In the meantime... Grab a seat.", "What'll it be?", 'But if you were, then maybe... ', 'Well? Most people would say something sweet right about now.', "Ahh, but you're a more discerning customer, aren't you? In which case... ", 'Our house special: the Cosmo Canyon.', 'I gotta go. Enjoy.', "I know we have to think big if we're going to make a difference. But not like this. I just... I feel trapped.", "Guess that's that, then.", 'We agreed to disagree. So—you want another drink?', 'Oh. Sure.', 'Avalanche!', "It's been too long since we did this.", "Can't believe it's already been a year. I don't know how we managed.", 'I guess it is kinda obvious!', 'Avalanche!', 'You guys... ', "We'll talk later. I promise.", "Don't take this the wrong way, but right now I need to spend time with the gang.", 'Heya. So... what did you wanna talk about?', "Should've figured. All the guys are leaving.", "The great war hero, huh? Mm... Isn't it pretty hard to become a SOLDIER?", "Guess not. Think you'll be in the papers?", "Just... promise me one thing. When we're older, and you're a famous SOLDIER... if I'm ever trapped or in trouble... Promise you'll come and save me.", "That's what heroes do. They save people. Please? Just once.", 'Come on, promise me!', "I know we have to think big if we're going to make a difference... but not like this. I just... Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Plate separation code is... Got it?', "Reno, what's happening? Do we have a problem?", 'More would-be heroes, huh? Sending reinforcements. The more players that take the stage, the better.', 'Contact me when the mission is complete.', "Change of plans. You can take it from here. Someone's been a little too adventurous.", 'You led us on a merry chase, Aerith.', 'Before you say another word, know that your options are limited.', 'Nothing. There is nothing you can do now.', 'Your activities unwittingly brought you into contact with the Ancient, who is now back in our custody where she belongs. For this, you have my sincerest gratitude. Alas, the sector in which you stand has been condemned.', 'And where exactly do you expect them to go?', "Aerith... You know you're not just any little girl. You're a descendant of the Ancients.", "But Aerith... Even when you're all alone, don't you hear voices whispering secrets?", 'You know, Reno. I think you might be due for some R&R.', ' "We" are going to do nothing.', "Had we refused, someone else would've completed the task. We have spared that someone the burden of a guilty conscience. Perhaps that will ease yours.", "Let's try another tack then. They were a sacrifice to balance the scales.", "After everything we've taken from the planet, we were due to give something back.", 'Does it matter?', 'Yes. Understood.', 'The VP needs us.', 'Is something wrong, sir?', 'I see. Very good.', 'The men are on standby, sir. Your orders?', '*Mister President*.']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Yeah, what he said!', "You'll keep us safe... right, Cloud?", "Wow, they've almost got the door.", "We're doing this. We're really doing it. Man... I think I'm gonna be sick... ", "C'mon, nobody'd do something this crazy just for money. *They* may not think you're a true believer, but you know what I think?", "Hey Cloud! Elevator's over there! Catch up soon!", 'See you later!', "I'll secure our escape route, okay? You go on and catch up with the others.", 'Keep them safe—please!', "Don't worry about me. Go!", 'Over here! This way!', "That'd be just down there!", 'You got it!', "Watch out for live wires. They're everywhere.", 'I felt that one in my guts... ', "Ugh. I'm running on empty here... ", "Next time, I'll have to bring a little pick-me-up.", 'Not far!', "That's about as good a place as any.", 'But what if it was... ?', 'And this is only the beginning... ', 'Later then!', "Guess Cloud won't be joining us after all... ", 'Lotta people here.', 'Ugh, so cramped... ', "Man, everyone's on edge.", 'Hey, Cloud, I... um... ', "Yeesh... You don't make it easy... ", "They'd probably kill us if they knew we were the ones responsible... ", "No-don't think about it.", 'You got somewhere you need to be?', 'Bombs detonated: one. Members lost: zero!', "When I get back, it's refuelin' time.", 'Oh, hey, Cloud. Looking to join the neighborhood watch?', 'That would work for everybody!', "I'll march through the streets singing your praises—even on an empty stomach!", "Won't be anyone who doesn't know about the new merc when we're through!", 'Working for the neighborhood watch is the best kind of cover.', 'You can go all over town, meet all kinds of people, and no one bats an eye.', 'You guys are machines!', "That sounds great! I'll come too!", 'No fair!', "C'mon, Jessie! I'm dying here!", 'Avalanche!', 'More reason to live it up now!', 'Not since we went on that all-night bender after HQ gave us the boot.', 'So long as someone looks out for my stomach!', 'That tickled!', "You know, it'd be really cool if we could do this again tomorrow night.", 'Avalanche!', 'Lemme treat you to dinner at my place! I can introduce you to all my cats!', "I'd offer to share but... you know.", 'Bet you could use a bit to eat too huh?', "Easy. You've been acting weird. Like, talking about one thing when you're obviously thinking about something else.", "No. We just figured you wanted to see your parents. That's all.", 'Yeah!', "Yes, ma'am!", 'Okay, you got it!', 'Just like that!?', "We're not screwed, are we!?", 'I *am* gunning it!', 'We made it!', 'Go team!', 'Hey, did these things leave a mark?', "Aw... *and* I'm running on fumes... ", "You really shouldn't go off on your own!", 'Over here, Cloud! Over here!', 'Where you trying to go?', 'Uh, Cloud? Hello?', "C'mere... Aw, no dice... Someone's playing hard to get.", 'Think she\'ll make us pizza? Her "Midgar Special"?', "It's a shame you won't get to try the Midgar Special. You would've really liked it.", "Don't mind if I do!", "I'll take another one, please!", 'So, got more pizza in the oven?', "I'm not full yet!", 'A lot of people really rely on Jessie.', 'So good!', 'Maybe just a couple slices, Missus R.', "Hey! I'm... I'm doing it for you guys! You don't want me going to work on an empty stomach.", "So what, does this mean we're gonna ask some Shinra folks out to dinner?", 'Her dad had an accident.', "Jessie's got a theory about it. Thinks her dad's spirit is stuck now—between his body and the heart of the planet. So if we don't shut down the reactors soon... ", "He's serious, Cloud! She'll beat the shit out of us!", "Hey! It's the lot Jessie was talking about. We rendezvous here when we've got what we came for.", "It's so quiet... ", "And I don't think it was Jessie.", "Hey, man, the plaza's that way. Warehouses are further in. Jessie's supposed to be circling around from the back, right... ?", "We're in this together!", 'You can use that vending machine over there to stock up!', "Man! I get really hungry when I'm nervous!", 'When you leave something at home, or just need a bite to eat, vending machines can be real lifesavers!', "Whenever you're ready, just let us know, Cloud!", 'And us?', "That's the signal!", 'Yeah!', 'And down she goes!', "Don't worry—I've got this!", "Tasty treats! Come and get 'em!", "Don't eat me! Please don't eat me!", "Midgar Special, don't fail me now!", 'Think I ran off the pizza... ', "I'm glad someone's enjoying themselves... ", "More than you know! Look what I found. Let's give these jerks a taste of their own medicine!", 'Hurry! Lead the sweepers toward the mines!', "Now that's what I call teamwork!", 'Run! Run while you can!', 'Glad yours is... ', 'Not my finest hour... ', 'Just winged, I think... Or shot!', 'You guys are the worst... ', 'Now *that* was a gunshot.', 'Copy that!', 'So how do we get back to the slums?', 'Where exactly are we going?', 'Uh—Cloud was just saying how he hopes to come back and try the Midgar Special next time!', "That'd be awesome!", 'Huh? Whaddya mean "half figured"!?', 'Wait! Gimme a minute!', 'Why do you have to be such a hard-ass, bro?', 'Yeah... ? Yeah... ', "I'll head home on my own. After all, I'm only a little sore... ", 'Aw, thanks, bro!', 'This way!', 'Think Jessie and Biggs made it back safe?', "Cool if we check on them? We'll pass by their places anyway.", "Well, this is Biggs's place. I guess he hasn't made it home yet.", 'Hope he isn\'t "worst case-ing" it again. He\'s got a habit of overthinking things. Worrying about all the possible outcomes till his head hurts.', "And when he worries, I worry. Anyway, let's head on over to Jessie's!", 'This is where Jessie lives. Men are not allowed inside.', "Lots of pretty girls trying to make it big onstage live here. So don't hang around or they might get the wrong idea.", "I'm telling you this for your own good, Cloud! People around here love to gossip.", "Nah, it's all good. They think she's an actress. Oh... and one more thing, bro. It's all a game to her. Don't fall for it!", " Life's a stage and love's the play!", "Guys aren't allowed, remember!?", 'Hey there, Biggums, Reggie, Smalls... Brought a new friend to meet you! These little guys are on guard duty today.', 'Thanks for seeing me home!', "S'all good, bro!", "Hey, don't be scared! Deep down, he's a big softie.", 'Aw, I missed you too!', 'Oh, Biggums! Acting so tough!', 'And you, Reggie... You are just the cutest!', 'Aw, Smalls! Do you want a belly rub?', 'Glad to see you guys are getting along just fine!', 'Hey, bro! Wanna chill with me and the gang for a bit?', 'The cats, dummy. Who else? Biggumus Rex, Reginaldo, Mister Smalls... ', 'Mind checking on the others again for me? Thanks! Oh, and have a good night!', 'What did you do to your leg!? D-does it hurt?', "But I'm in perfect health!", 'Ah, forgot to give this to you, bro. Your prize for taking the top spot on the darts leaderboard. You earned it. After you guys come back from the plate, maybe we can play a round together?', "I'm counting on you, bro... Don't let anything happen to the others.", 'Good luck out there, bro. And take care.', "With old Wedge in charge, this place'll be safer than ever!", "Cloud... It's Shinra! They're trying to take out the pillar!", 'Hang on, guys! Help is coming!', 'That was a close one... ', 'Much better, thanks.', "Consider it done! Now get up there and kick Shinra's ass!", "C'mon—Seventh Heaven is this way!", "You guys can't stay here! Come on, come on!", "I'm no good—not to anyone up there or down here... ", "You don't think we're gonna stop them from dropping the plate, do you? I wanna believe that we can still win somehow.", "But... something in my gut tells me we're due for a reckoning. Just this... feeling. Know what I mean?", " I'm not sure what's gonna happen next. But I am sure I don't wanna regret the choices I make tonight. Our lives are in your hands. If you don't open up, we're all gonna die!", "Head straight and look right—you can't miss it!", "Alright, I'll get these people to safety!", "There's no time, guys! You've got to get out of Sector 7 as quickly as you can! We'll have a better chance to survive if we work together!", 'Hey guys! Long time no see!', "HQ's running the show this time. They're raising hell to try and flush out the president.", 'Find a way to the roof. An Avalanche chopper will come to extract you.', 'I asked them really nicely! Like, super-duper nicely!', 'Just get to the roof, okay?', "We're cool. Everything's cool.", 'Barret!', 'Not again!', 'Just... tell me that—that I made a difference... ', "And when they do, we're gonna treat 'em to a feast! I can almost taste your pizza now, Jessie!", 'What!?', "There, there... Don't worry. They'll be back soon. I promise.", "We're all sad they aren't here, but we gotta be brave.", "It'd be my pleasure!", " Pretty sure I'll hold my own. I eat experts for breakfast!", "Not gonna lie... I didn't think you had a chance. Sure showed me.", 'Ugh!']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Hm. Stronger than I’ve ever been… A big claim, little man.', 'Now… Who do I kill?', 'They shall be slashed, strangled, and slaughtered. Beaten, stabbed, and crushed. (laughs) Either way, see you in Deepground.', 'Sleep well?', 'These idiots want to "digitally replicate" me, so I\'m indulging them.', ' Looking forward to this?']

Title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
Dialogues: ['Hey there, Tifa! You need a helping hand?', "Hah, you don't say! Well, we're always on the lookout for experienced fighters to help us deal with the bigger critters.", "Experienced *and* cocky, huh? If it's a challenge you want, I might have a few good ones. Your clients can fill you in on the details. Prove yourself with these jobs, and I'll see if I can't find you some more.", "You're gonna have to talk to your clients if you want all the details.", "You'll never want for work around here if you prove yourself useful.", 'Do me proud now, and I just might have more work for you later.', 'Hey, I got another job for you, merc.', "A certain shopkeeper told me you paid him a visit. Thanks for helping him out. Just so happens there's another job I'd like to offer you, now that I know you can handle yourself in a fight.", "We've got a real killer on the loose, you see. A rabid catch dog. Maybe you heard people talking about it? Shinra mutt gone feral. Last sighting was in Scrap Boulevard. Think you're up to it?", "You're a lifesaver! Doubt anyone else around here stands a chance! Go get 'em, bud.", 'The catch dog was last seen in Scrap Boulevard, but if it wanders into town, a lot of people could get hurt.', "This is no ordinary dog, my friend. Damn thing's already put a few of the watch out of commission.", 'What idiot let that ugly mutt loose in the first place?', 'Hey! Over here! Tifa! Hey, Cloud!', "I drove the hound into the area up ahead. He's pissed, so make sure you're ready.", 'Took care of the dog, did ya? Phew! We owe you one.', 'Oh, today. The first reports came in just this morning. Uh... why do you ask?', "Wait a minute... There's this crazy story about a Shinra research lab hidden right beneath our feet—under the slums.", " And here I thought you might know something I don't! Well, I guess not.", "Yeah, fair enough. You got the bastard. That's good enough for me.", 'A new breed of attack dog, huh? Not something you see every day—around here, at least.', "Can't thank you enough for everything you've done lately.", "I didn't tell you this, but you've inspired some of our people to hit the training room, believe it or not.", 'Well, I sure do hope that we can count on your assistance in the future, Cloud.', "I'll make sure everyone knows just how much you've done for us.", "Still can't believe how badly tht mutt hurt out guys. We're getting soft. Might need a new training regimen.", 'Still in one piece.', 'I wish I knew... Sorry.', 'This is bad.', 'We need able-bodied men and women.', "We can't afford to lose any more lives. Not now.", "I don't even know where to start.", 'This is bad.', 'Oh, hey Barret.', 'Well, yeah. So help us out.', "I've been hearing reports of howling from deep underground.", "You took care of those monsters? Oh, thank you! That's one less big problem to worry about. We owe you.", "You too, buddy. But hey, we're grounders. We don't break easy. I know it's not much, but take this, with my thanks.", "Hey! Over here! Can't belive those freakin' morons... They damn near got 'emselves eaten tryin' to hide that stupid poster. You stay away from that factory, y'hear? Place has monsters comin' outta the walls.", "Fiends've been actin' up since the bombings—like they know something we don't. (sighs) Just wish that merc were still around. He'd sort those critters out."]
